jobs.title: Senior GTM Manager
jobs.description:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

🚀 The Role

We’re hiring a Senior GTM Manager to join the Buy Engine.

tem predominantly sells through a partner network to SME businesses, and this role owns partner activation from systems to story. You’ll build the automation layer that makes the programme scalable, run the events and community engine that builds trust in market, drive the ABM plays that generate targeted pipeline, and translate tem’s product complexity into narratives partners and buy-side clients actually use. The metric you move is new pipeline generated.

The job requires two gears running in parallel. You ship fast, drawing on experience rather than waiting for a brief. And you zoom out regularly to build the systems that mean the next quarter is easier than this one.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Ship the agentic workflows that take the manual drag out of events, partner comms, and product marketing.

  • Build our events programme into a system that enables more in-person and community engagement across the UK and abroad.

  • Run ABM plays that generate new pipeline, with clear leading metrics helping you iterate quickly.

  • Turn tem’s most complex product and pricing innovation into positioning partners can sell.

  • Develop the automated product launch workflow, from PM spec through to go-to-market brief.

🛠️ Responsibilities

  • Build and automate: design and ship the agentic workflows that remove manual drag from events, partner comms, and product marketing, and keep building the GTM automation stack as the programme grows.

  • Run partner activation: own the events programme end to end, drive stickiness and engagement on our core activation channels, and run GTM experiments inside tem’s fortnightly sprint rhythm, compounding the playbook sprint by sprint.

  • Translate complexity into narrative: turn the hardest parts of energy into positioning partners can sell and customers are persuaded by, and keep the market story consistent and specific.

  • Own the intelligence loop: turn customer insights into structured signals that actively challenge and improve our positioning and GTM priorities, and own competitive intelligence on our key GTM bets.

  • Measure what matters: track what each activation play costs in time and money and what it returns in pipeline, own the reporting inside the fortnightly rhythm, and build the institutional memory that means the engine doesn’t reset when people join or leave.

✅ Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Builder orientation: you ship fast, draw on experience, and don’t need a fully formed brief to move.

  • Systems thinking in parallel: you can zoom out from daily execution to build the infrastructure that scales the programme, and do both at once.

  • Marketing literacy across the full GTM stack: positioning, narrative, activation, and channel strategy.

  • Hands-on, daily use of AI or no-code tools, with evidence you’ve built real workflows rather than one-off experiments.

  • B2B or B2B2C channel experience: you’ve marketed through or to a partner network, not just direct.

  • Comfortable operating at pace in a Series B environment where the playbook is being written as you go and the standards matter.

Desirable

  • Experience owning or contributing to an ABM programme.

  • Community or events programme ownership.

  • Exposure to complex or regulated industries where product narrative is genuinely hard, such as energy, fintech, infrastructure, or healthcare.

🎁 Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to £1,200 or €1,200 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to £150 or €150 per month for wellbeing.

🤝 Interview Process

We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. If you need us to adapt anything, let us know.

  • First call with our Talent Team.

  • Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager.

  • Technical Interview with the Team (90 mins). You’ll meet with potential peers in this session and will discuss your approach to GTM systems design and partner activation.

  • Bar Raiser Interview with Stakeholders.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

That sounds cool — what does a Customer Success Manager have to do with it?

Accurx works with 41 of the 42 NHS ICBs in primary care and is growing fast in secondary care. The relationships that make that possible — the trust, the renewals, the accounts that stay with us even when competitors come knocking on price — are owned by our Customer Success team.

We’re hiring three CSMs to grow the team across both primary and secondary care. You’ll own a portfolio of enterprise NHS accounts end-to-end, from implementation through to renewal. In primary care, it’s about protecting and deepening relationships that are already strong. In secondary care, it’s about building them from scratch in a market where Accurx Scribe is winning big and growing fast. Either way, it’s about being the person NHS organisations trust — the one who knows their priorities, anticipates problems before they arise, and makes Accurx genuinely indispensable.

The challenges you’ll solve as a Customer Success Manager

  • Own your NHS accounts end-to-end. You’ll manage a portfolio of 5–11 ICB or Trust enterprise accounts — building relationships, driving adoption, leading renewals, and keeping Accurx sticky even when the NHS is in flux. You’re the person your customers call first.

  • Build trust where Accurx is new. In secondary care, we’re expanding quickly into a more complex environment. You’ll help NHS Trusts get real outcomes from Accurx Scribe — building processes that don’t yet exist and earning the kind of trust we’ve spent years building in primary care.

  • Be a connector, not just an account manager. You’ll work across marketing, implementation, transformation, commercial ops, and finance. The best CSMs here don’t just manage accounts — they bring the voice of the customer back into the business and make things better for the whole team.

  • Build the playbook as you go. The team is scaling and many of our processes are still being written. You’ll contribute to and shape how account management works at Accurx. What works gets codified; what doesn’t gets challenged.

  • Navigate the NHS with patience and precision. NHS organisations are under enormous pressure — restructuring, funding uncertainty, stakeholder churn. You’ll hold relationships through difficult periods and keep Accurx front of mind even when it’s not their immediate priority.

You should apply if...

  • You own relationships, not just accounts. You’ve worked in customer success, account management, or a relationship-heavy role and you know the difference between being a yes-person and being a trusted advisor. Accurx has no commission plan — success here is measured by trust, retention, and real outcomes.

  • You push back constructively. You don’t jump when a customer says jump. You ask why — more than once — and you find a better solution. You’re empathetic but not a pushover.

  • You’re comfortable building from scratch. Processes aren’t fully defined here. You’d rather create structure than wait for someone else to do it, and you’re okay if the first version isn’t perfect.

  • You’re curious about the NHS. Whether you’ve worked in or around it or you’re coming in fresh — you’re genuinely interested in how it works and patient enough to navigate its complexity.

  • You’re AI-native. You use AI tools to work smarter — automating the routine so you can spend more time on the things that actually need you.

  • You’re a natural connector. You’re as comfortable in a room with a clinical lead as you are with a Trust’s Head of Digital Transformation or a commercial director. You adapt your style and bring people with you.

What’s in it for me?

You’ll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we’re led by our Principles and our mission to Solve Healthcare Productivity.

  • £50,000 – £70,000 salary + share options up to £15,000

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Flexible Working: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am–4pm

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Family matters: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own Chef! Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches will be provided, with the occasional sweet treat!

Want to know more about the company or the hiring process? Check out our Careers page and Candidate hub.

Find us across social media: Medium, LinkedIn, X, Instagram and YouTube.

Diversity and Equal Opportunities: We are an equal opportunities employer and a pleasant and supportive place to work. We particularly welcome applications from those who are significantly underrepresented in the technology sector, such as women, non-binary people, transgender people, people with disabilities, LGBTQIA+ community and individuals from Black and Minority Ethnic communities.

Compensation: £50K – £70K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Senior Performance Marketing Executive (B2C)
jobs.description:
What we do. Electric Car Leasing

Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future.


Consumer growth at Octopus Electric Vehicles has accelerated quickly over the last two years, and paid media is a huge part of how we reach more drivers and grow the business.

We're looking for a brilliant Senior Performance Marketing Executive to take day-to-day ownership of our paid digital activity - with one big goal: help us get more from every pound we spend.

This is a hands-on role for someone who loves performance marketing at the detail level. You'll be in Google Ads regularly, analysing search terms, adjusting budgets and bids, spotting wasted spend, testing new approaches and working out where we can improve conversion and scale efficiently.

Paid search will be at the heart of the role, and you'll also help us explore and grow channels like Paid Social, Display and Programmatic, testing where they can add incremental value to our existing activity. 

You'll sit within our B2C Growth squad, reporting into the Senior Consumer Growth Marketing Manager, and work closely with our Content Creator, Design, Commercial and wider Marketing teams.

This would suit someone with strong hands-on performance marketing experience, perhaps from an agency or fast-paced in-house environment, who wants more ownership, more visibility and more opportunity to influence what happens next.


What you'll do

  • 🚀 Own our paid media campaigns: Build, manage and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads and Meta, with paid search as your core focus initially.

  • 💰 Make our spend work harder: Identify wasted spend, underperforming campaigns and opportunities to improve efficiency, with clear recommendations on where to push, pause, reduce or reallocate budget.

  • 📈 Optimise towards the outcomes that matter: Look beyond clicks and leads to understand which campaigns and audiences are driving better-quality customers and orders, and use that insight to improve performance.

  • 🖥️ Help us grow Display and Programmatic: Identify opportunities across prospecting and retargeting, shape audiences and creative approaches, launch tests, analyse performance and recommend where there is a genuine opportunity to scale.

  • 📊 Stay close to performance: Monitor spend, pacing and key metrics, spot changes quickly and turn the numbers into clear, practical recommendations.

  • 🧪 Test, learn and improve: Work with our Content Creator and Design team to test messaging, creative, formats, audiences and landing-page approaches.

  • 🎯 Keep campaigns clean and measurable: Make sure tracking, UTMs, audiences, naming conventions and campaign structures are set up properly so we can trust the data we're using to make decisions.

  • 🌐 Help improve what happens after the click: Support campaign landing pages and other digital experiences, including drafting copy and building or updating pages using our web tools when needed.

  • 🤝 Make campaigns happen: Coordinate briefs, creative, links, tracking and launches across the team so activity gets live quickly.


What you'll need

Strong hands-on paid search experience. You're confident building, managing and optimising Google Ads campaigns yourself, from search terms and match types to bidding, budgets and campaign structure.

A proper performance mindset. You naturally look at an account and ask: Where are we wasting money? What could perform better? What should we test next?

Good commercial judgement. You know the cheapest click or lead isn't always the best one, and you're interested in what actually drives better-quality customers and orders.

Confidence managing paid media budgets. You're comfortable keeping an eye on pacing, spotting where performance is changing and recommending where spend should move.

Experience with Display or Programmatic. Ideally, you've worked hands-on with Display campaigns, DV360, Campaign Manager 360 or similar platforms. You don't need to be a programmatic specialist, but you should understand the basics and be excited to help us grow this area.

Some paid social experience. Experience with Meta Ads Manager or other paid social platforms would be useful.

You're comfortable with the technical detail. You understand why conversion tracking, UTMs, audiences, naming conventions and clean campaign setup matter, and you're happy digging into data to work out what's going on.

Around 2-4 years of hands-on performance marketing experience, ideally in an agency, media business or fast-paced in-house environment. We're flexible on exact years - what matters most is your technical ability, curiosity and attitude.

Most importantly, you enjoy doing the work. You like being in-platform, finding opportunities and making things better, and you're proactive, commercially minded, low-ego and great to work with. Things move quickly here, priorities change and everyone pitches in, so you'll thrive if you're happy getting stuck in, helping others and figuring things out as you go.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Future Hiring)
jobs.description:
About SugarAI UK Limited

SugarAI is redefining CRM for the age of AI.

We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next.

More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. We’re focused on solving complex, real-world challenges where relationships, context, and precision make all the difference.

Our global team is united by a shared commitment to impact, ownership, and continuous growth. We create an environment where thoughtful ideas move quickly, where people are trusted to lead, and where flexibility supports how great work gets done.

If you’re excited to help shape what’s next in AI-driven CRM—and build technology that drives real outcomes—we’d love to meet you.

Where You Fit In: 
SugarAI ships AI-powered selling and sales intelligence products in a market that moves faster every day. We are focused on quality, functionality, and speed to delivery, and the engineers who thrive here don't treat AI tools as a productivity add-on they've fundamentally changed how they work, using agentic development workflows to go from specification to production-ready code faster than they could before, without sacrificing correctness or quality. 

This is not a role for someone who favors traditional software development, or is curious about AI-assisted development and plans to explore it. It's a role for someone who already works this way who writes clear, machine-readable specifications that feed the agentic development system, uses agentic development tools as standard equipment, and applies genuine critical judgment to what these tools produce before it ships. You'll build systems and features that power real customer outcomes in a B2B SaaS platform at scale, and you'll do it inside a delivery model where human judgment is the differentiating input, not the bottleneck. 

If you want to work on meaningful software with teammates who hold the bar high on both speed and craft, this role is for you.

This role operates on a hybrid model, with a mix of remote work and in-office collaboration at our Solihull location, specifically, working in-office a minimum of 2 days per week.

 

Disclaimer: When applying to this job posting, you are submitting your application for consideration of a role which may or may not actually exist, or be available now or in the future. Application submission is agreeing to be added to our Applicant Tracking System database, so we have the potential to surface your profile and reach out to you in the future, for opportunities which appear to be aligned to your background, experience or network.
 
To be considered for a specific job opening, please check out our Careers Page and apply to an active job posting. 

Impact You Will Make in the Role (Key Responsibilities): 

Agentic Development Systems 

  • Work from executable specifications — write clear SDD/BDD specs and acceptance criteria as the primary input for AI-assisted code generation, and keep them current as implementation evolves 

  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) as standard equipment across the full SDLC, from spec to implementation to test generation to code review 

  • Apply critical judgment to AI-generated code and agentic attestations before merge — assess correctness, edge cases, security implications, and alignment with the spec; your review is a real gate, not a formality 

  • Contribute to the team's agentic development practices: spec standards, attestation norms, and how the team uses AI tools responsibly 

Feature Delivery 

  • Design, implement, and ship features and components that are reliable, maintainable, and built to perform in high volume, high-availability SaaS environments 

  • Ensure agentic code is clean, well tested, and follows the standards that make it easy to understand and extend by both agentic systems and your teammates 

  • Own your feature areas end-to-end, from understanding the requirement to production delivery, including identifying and resolving defects before they reach customers 

Code Quality & Review 

  • Review outputs, including AI-generated code and agentic attestations, with the care and rigor the team depends on; catch what automation misses 

  • Orchestrate unit and integration test development that verifies real behaviour, not just execution paths; apply the same critical eye to test quality as to production code 

  • Contribute to the team's technical standards and raise the bar on engineering operations excellence across all facets of our AI SDLC 

Collaboration & Systems Thinking 

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to understand requirements and build the right thing, not just the specified thing 

  • Think beyond your immediate feature: understand the systems your code interacts with, the data it produces, and the downstream effects of your design decisions 

  • Communicate clearly in writing in specs, in code reviews, in async updatesto keep cross-functional and globally distributed teams aligned 

  • Participate in agile and team ceremonies, including Sprint Review, Program Reviews, and other technical presentations 


What You Will Bring (Qualifications/Experience): 

  • 2–5 years of experience developing enterprise or SaaS software in production environments 

  • Personal fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) you use these in your daily work and real delivery scenarios, not as an experiment 

  • Hands-on experience with BDD/SDD frameworks and working from executable specifications as the primary input to development, this is how we work, not a practice you're learning on the job 

  • Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or modern SaaS language; comfort picking up new languages and frameworks as the work demands 

  • Experience with RESTful API design and consumption 

  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores 

  • Experience producing and maintaining automated test suites (unit, integration, or end-to-end) 

  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with CI/CD pipelines 

  • Strong written communication skills; able to write clear specs, meaningful code review feedback, and async updates for a global team 


Preferred Qualifications/Experience: 

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent) and microservices architectures 

  • Familiarity with containerization, infrastructure-as-code, or observability tooling 

  • Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML features in a production SaaS product 

  • Background in B2B SaaS, CRM, or revenue technology 

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable; and passion goes a long way. Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of dedication, impact, and the ability to thrive in a fluid and collaborative environment. We want you to learn new things in this role, and we encourage you to apply if your experience is close to what we’re looking for. We also know that diversity of background and thought makes for better problem solving and more creative thinking, which is why we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.

jobs.title: Legal & Operation Officer - Private Clients - Flemish Brabant
jobs.description:
Our client is a highly respected Belgian boutique advisory firm founded by two former lawyers from leading international law firms. The organization supports high-profile prestigious clients and their families throughout every stage of their personal and professional journey.

Combining legal expertise, wealth structuring coordination, contract advisory, estate planning support, tax coordination, and day-to-day administrative assistance, the firm delivers a unique and highly personalized service to a portfolio of more than 100 clients across Belgium and internationally.

With a close-knit team of around 10-15 professionals, the company offers an entrepreneurial environment where quality, trust, and excellence are at the heart of everything they do.


Jobomschrijving

As a Legal Counsel your responsibilities are:

  • Advise and assist clients on a wide range of legal matters.
  • Review, draft, and coordinate contractual documentation.
  • Support matters relating to estate planning, wealth structuring, insurance, and family law.
  • Coordinate real estate transactions, including purchase agreements, leases, and notarial processes.
  • Liaise with external advisors including notaries, tax experts, accountants, and legal counsel.
  • Provide practical support regarding social security, invoicing, and administrative matters.
  • Organize and structure client files while ensuring excellent follow-up.
  • Monitor deadlines, legal documentation, and ongoing projects.
  • Deliver pragmatic and solutions-oriented legal guidance.
  • Communicate legal concepts in a simple and accessible manner.

A successful Legal Counsel should have:

  • Belgian Master's degree in Law
  • Legal professional as from 3 years of experience are welcome to apply.
  • Strong analytical skills and legal reasoning.
  • Excellent organizational and planning abilities.
  • Detail-oriented, critical thinker, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
  • Fluent in Dutch & English
  • Proactive and hands-on personality.
  • Mature enough to work autonomously while knowing when to seek guidance.
  • Genuine willingness to learn and develop.
  • Comfortable working in an environment where responsibility comes early.

jobs.title: Enthusiastic operators
jobs.description:
Company

Founded in Belgium in 1935, our client has grown into an international leader in sustainable packaging solutions. Their packaging—from corrugated cardboard and solid board to tubes and protective corners—is produced with recycled paper and is 100% recyclable and biodegradable. With a long-term vision and focus on sustainability, they combine ecological and economic progress. Their products, relationships, and management style all contribute to a greener planet. Today, our client has 6,500 employees, spread across 70 locations in 21 countries. The headquarters is located in Aalst.


Jobomschrijving

For the location in Hoogstraten, our client is looking for enthusiastic operators.

Curious about how paper and cardboard are made? With our client, you will learn it all!

As an operator, you play a crucial role in the production process. These are your responsibilities:

  • Setting up, operating, and monitoring machines for the production of paper and cardboard products.
  • Starting and stopping machines according to prescribed procedures.
  • Performing quality checks on products during the production process.
  • Ensuring a smooth production process with your colleagues.
  • Performing first-line maintenance on the machines.
  • Reporting technical malfunctions and working with the technical department to resolve them.

Monitoring the safety instructions and ensuring they are applied in the workplace

Eager to learn and interested in growth opportunities? Then you are the operator our client is looking for!

  • Working in a production environment doesn’t scare you, even if it’s noisy.
  • You are a handy person with an interest in technology.
  • You value safety, order, cleanliness, and quality.
  • You are open to feedback and see it as an opportunity to grow.
  • You demonstrate responsibility and are always ready to help others.
  • You have basic PC skills.
  • You will be employed in a 2-shift or 5-shift system.
  • You speak good Dutch or English.

jobs.title: Orderpicker Lego
jobs.description:
Kuehne + Nagel is one of the world's leading logistics companies.


Jobomschrijving

Orderpickers Wanted!

Location: Tessenderlo 

  • Do you have some experience in logistics?
  • Are you the type who likes order (and order picking)?
  • Do you secretly enjoy the satisfying beep of a scanner?

Then step right up – we have the job for you!

We're on the hunt for motivated warehouse workers !

What you’ll be doing:

•            Picking and packing orders (yes, sometimes toys – try not to play with them)

•            Scanning goods like a supermarket champion

•            Cruising on an electric pallet truck like it’s your own warehouse Uber

•            Keeping the warehouse tidy and organized (you know… like a grown-up version of Tetris)

•            Sorting returns and updating the stock – Sherlock Holmes style ?

•            Charging batteries (the ones on machines, not yours – coffee helps with that )

jobs.title: Orderpicker m/v/x
jobs.description:
Kuehne+Nagel heeft een rijke geschiedenis in de logistieke sector. Met meer dan 125 jaar ervaring kan ze zich een echte expert noemen. Goederen beheren, opslaan en transporteren vormen het hart van de business.


Jobomschrijving

Build Your Career with Kuehne+Nagel

With over 125 years of experience, Kuehne+Nagel is one of the world's leading logistics providers. Every day, millions of products are stored, managed, and delivered through innovative supply chain solutions. Join our international team in Geel and help bring LEGO products to customers around the globe!

Your Responsibilities

As a Warehouse Operator in the LEGO department, you will:

  • Pick LEGO products using a picking list.
  • Pack and prepare orders for shipment.
  • Perform quality checks to ensure products meet the required standards.
  • Move goods manually or with an electric pallet truck (BT).
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe working environment.

No experience operating an electric pallet truck? Don't worry! We provide full on-the-job training.

You are:

  • Motivated and eager to learn.
  • Available to work in a 2-shift system.
  • A reliable team player with good communication skills.
  • Detail-oriented and committed to safety and quality.
  • Flexible and willing to work occasional weekends when needed.

jobs.title: Captain for Tugboat
jobs.description:
Company Activities:

Join a company committed to excellence in maritime operations. Our client prides themselves on their dedication to safety, innovation, and teamwork. Their mission is to deliver top-notch dredging services with a focus on environmental sustainability and client satisfaction. As part of their team, you’ll be contributing to projects that shape the waterways of northern Europe, ensuring they remain navigable and efficient for all maritime traffic.


Jobomschrijving

Are you a skilled Captain for Tugboat looking for an exciting opportunity to showcase your expertise? Join our client’s dynamic team and navigate the waters of northern France and Belgium. Your primary mission will be to provide essential support to a dredging pontoon, ensuring smooth operations and safe passage through these regions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Navigate and operate the tugboat efficiently in collaboration with dredging operations.
  • Ensure the mechanical upkeep of the tugboat, supported by the client’s team of technicians.
  • Maintain tidiness and order on board, ensuring a safe and pleasant environment.
  • Coordinate with French-speaking and Flemish-speaking teams to ensure seamless communication and operations.

Profile Description:

Our client is seeking an independent and responsible individual to take on the role of Captain for Tugboat. The ideal candidate will possess:

  • A strong mechanical knowledge, essential for the maintenance and operation of the tugboat.
  • CRR holder credentials.
  • A driving licence and access to a car for easy mobility.
  • A B licence (river) and A licence (river + coastal) to navigate various waterways.
  • Proficiency in English, French, or Dutch to effectively communicate with diverse teams.

jobs.title: Construction worker
jobs.description:
Our client specializes in dredging works. They provide dredging and maintenance services for waterways, ports and coastlines. Their scope of work includes sediment removal, land reclamation, and improving navigability.

Work location: The company headquarters is located in Zwijnaarde; projects are in the Ghent area

Responsibilities:

• Close cooperation with other team members and the site manager.

jobs.title: Driver C/CE
jobs.description:
Our client has over 100 years of expertise in cleaning and renting high-quality textiles. They provide their services to hospitals, healthcare institutions, and holiday parks in both the Netherlands and Belgium. Known for being accessible, nearby, and highly engaged, they are dedicated to delivering exceptional service and maintaining strong relationships with their clients. Joining their team means contributing to a legacy of excellence and reliability in the textile industry.


Jobomschrijving

Are you an experienced Driver with a passion for delivering excellent service? Our client is looking for dedicated Drivers to join their team in Oedelem (Oostkamp/Bruges). This is an exciting opportunity to work with a company that values reliability, professionalism, and teamwork.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Operate vehicles (C and CE licenses) on fixed routes from Monday to Friday.
  • Drive 50% of the time and assist with loading/unloading 50% of the time.
  • Ensure timely and safe delivery of goods.

  • Valid C or CE driving license, medical clearance, and Code 95 certification.
  • Excellent command of Dutch, French, or English.

jobs.title: Production Operator (with housing)
jobs.description:
Company Activities

Our client is more than just a packaging glass producer. They are a family business with an international outlook, driven by technology, sustainability, and people.

In our client’s IS Department (Glass Forming Department, Hot End), molten glass arrives from the glass furnace, where it is cut into gobs and transported via the feeder to the production line. The glass gob then drops into a mould, where it is blown into shape and coated with a hot-end coating. Within this department, you will play a key role in operating, monitoring, and adjusting the process while ensuring quality and efficiency.


Jobomschrijving

As an Operator within the production department of our client, you will find yourself at the beating heart of their glass organization.

We do provide housing.

We do not provide work permits.

Key responsibilities:

  • Ensure the smooth operation of the production process by controlling and monitoring gob control systems, the lehr, and conveyor systems, adjusting process parameters, and checking temperature values.
  • Prepare the required equipment prior to production changeovers and replace refractory components when needed.
  • Clean and maintain machinery, installations, and the working environment.
  • Identify, report, and accurately document technical malfunctions and process deviations.
  • Monitor product quality by carrying out inspections and measurements (including weight, heat, and temperature checks) and maintaining records such as process data, mould numbers, and production settings.
  • Provide a thorough shift handover to the incoming team at the end of your shift.

The following criteria are important:

  • Experience in a production environment.
  • Willingness to attend training sessions during the day at various training locations.
  • Ability to work with a computer.
  • Good command of English or Dutch.
  • Actively contribute to a pleasant team atmosphere and be helpful to colleagues.
  • Flexible with the task package, especially during the startup phase.
  • No issues with working in a warm environment (temperatures up to 40 degrees).
  • Physical work does not deter you.
  • Basic technical knowledge.

jobs.title: Bus Mechanic
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established company operating in all segments of passenger transport, including public transport, school and company transport, and coach tourism services. With multiple locations across Belgium and Luxembourg, they are looking for a skilled Bus Mechanic to strengthen their garage team in Affligem or Lede.


Jobomschrijving

 

Your Responsibilities

  • Independently perform both simple and complex mechanical and electrical repairs and installations on buses.
  • Carry out preventive maintenance and diagnostics.
  • Report all maintenance and repair work accurately using the company's garage application.
  • Take the lead when necessary and provide support and guidance to fellow technicians.
  • Participate in technical training courses provided by various bus manufacturers.

You have a solid technical background in vehicle mechanics.

You have knowledge of vehicle electronics and can read electrical diagrams.

You are passionate about technology and work accurately, safely, and independently.

You hold a technical secondary education (TSO) diploma in Automotive Technology or have equivalent experience.

You are proactive, able to identify technical issues, and find effective solutions.

You communicate well in English, Dutch, or French.

Experience with the maintenance of suspension systems, brakes, filters, and general vehicle servicing is required.

Experience working on trucks is an advantage; experience with buses is even better.

A Category B driving licence is considered an asset, as occasional roadside assistance may be required.

jobs.title: Electrical Maintenance Technician
jobs.description:
Company Activities:

Our client is part of the circular economy based on wood fibers. In Belgium, the company has three units employing around 600 employees. The plant in Langerbrugge (Ghent) produces high-quality newspaper and magazine paper from 100% recycled paper. Thanks to two biomass power plants that provide the necessary process steam and three wind turbines, the company is one of the most sustainable enterprises in North Sea Port. Safety is the top priority, and thanks to intensive training programs, employees develop both professionally and personal


Jobomschrijving

Our client, a leading global producer of renewable solutions for paper, packaging, pulp, and wood constructions, is looking for an Electrical Maintenance Technician. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and maintaining the electrical network up to a voltage level of 150 kV.

Your daily tasks will include:

  • Managing the lighting network.
  • Maintaining fire detection systems.
  • Operating frequency converters (ABB, Siemens, Danfoss).
  • Controlling various types of power switches (Siemens, ABB).

The ideal candidate should:

  • Hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.
  • Have several years of experience in a similar role in an industrial production environment.
  • Be passionate about electricity and keep up-to-date with the latest trends in the field.
  • Think pragmatically and solve problems.
  • Plan and organize work effectively, with a focus on achieving results.
  • Communicate in English or Dutch at a good level.

jobs.title: Kvalitetsmedveten förvaltningschef för socialtjänst med invånaren i fokus
jobs.description:
Vi söker dig som vill vara med och forma morgondagens Ale. Hos oss är du med och levererar service och tjänster av bästa kvalitet till Aleborna. Tillsammans skapar 2 500 medarbetare ett Ale, kommunen som fokuserar på invånarna och deras behov. Bli en av oss!

Om arbetsplatsen

Ale kommun är en expansiv kommun i Göteborgsregionen där en nyligen antagen vision och värdegrund ska leda kommunen in i framtiden.

Socialförvaltningen är en av fyra förvaltningar som tillsammans med kommunledningsförvaltningen utgör tjänsteorganisationen i Ale kommun med omkring 125 chefer och 2500 medarbetare. Den kommunövergripande ledningsgruppen består av kommunchef, fyra förvaltningschefer samt fyra avdelningschefer.

Socialchefen tillsammans med fem verksamhetschefer utgör förvaltningens ledning. Totalt består socialtjänsten av omkring 850 medarbetare inom äldreomsorg, kommunal hälso- och sjukvård, funktionsstöd och individ- och familjeomsorg. Förvaltningen omsätter omkring 750 mkr.

Arbetsuppgifter

Förvaltningschefen är en viktig aktör i den koncernövergripande ledningen, styrningen och utvecklingen. Ansvar för verksamhet, ekonomi och arbetsgivarroll utgör grunden för vardagens uppdrag.

Som ytterst ansvarig tjänsteperson och uppdragstagare inför nämnd ingår att säkerställa att nämnden är informerad om verksamhetens innehåll, utveckling och arbetsgivaruppdraget samt att ärenden bereds enligt grunderna i god förvaltning – legalitet, objektivitet och proportionalitet.

Kvalifikationer

För rollen krävs akademisk examen, minst kandidatexamen, med inriktning för verksamhetsområdet som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant. Du ska flerårig erfarenhet som chef för chefer samt av arbete i en politiskt styrd organisation. Du behöver ha förmågan att uttrycka dig väl på svenska i såväl tal som skrift och ha en god digital förståelse.

Vi ser gärna att du har vidareutbildning inom socialt arbete, juridik, och/eller ledning och styrning. Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda ledare, verksamhetsutveckling samt uppnå mätbara förbättringar inom arbetsmiljö, medarbetarengagemang, sjukfrånvaro och personalomsättning.

Du behöver ha helhetssyn utifrån kommunkoncern och samhälle, en stor personlig mognad och ett välutvecklat omdöme. Dessutom en god förmåga att samarbeta. Du är strategisk och innovativ samt har alltid invånare, näringsliv och besökare i fokus.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

Övrigt

Ansökan och rekryteringsprocess

Sista ansökningsdag är söndag 11 oktober. I denna rekrytering samarbetar vi med Randstad. Rekryteringsprocessen inleds med en kompetensbaserad intervju med Randstad. Därefter genomförs en andra intervju av arbetsgivaren och verksamheten tillsammans med en facklig representant. I de sista stegen i processen ingår arbetsrelaterade tester samt referenstagning.

Samtliga ansökningar hanteras av Randstad och skickas in via följande länk:

https://www.randstad.se/jobb/forvaltningschef-for-socialtjanst_nol_2b5190ca-57c5-4c78-b4a7-30c5e97ca3eb/

Har du frågor kring tjänsten eller processen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Pernilla Håkansson på pernilla.hakansson@randstad.se eller 070-160 64 46.

Innan presentation görs till Ale kommun är inga uppgifter att ses som allmän offentlig handling.

Vår värdegrund bygger på att tillsammans tar vi ansvar och skapar förtroende. Vi är måna om att våra medarbetare i Ale mår bra och erbjuder där det är möjligt flexibel arbetstid, friskvårdsbidrag samt förmånliga kollektivavtal. Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta i Ale kommun? Läs mer här: https://ale.se/om-kommunen/jobba-i-ale-kommun.html

Tillsammans skapar vi möjligheter, här finns en plats för alla och vi har nära till varandra.



Har du skyddade personuppgifter ska du INTE söka via systemet utan kontakta rekryteringsansvarig för hantering av din ansökan.

För att underlätta rekryteringsarbetet ber vi dig att bifoga relevanta intyg och betyg för tjänsten du söker samt vid eventuell intervju ha möjlighet att uppvisa giltig ID-handling. Vi har endast möjlighet att ta emot ansökningar via Varbi.

Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund. Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta i Ale kommun? Läs mer här: Jobba i Ale kommun | Ale kommun

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

Vi använder e-rekrytering för att effektivisera och kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsarbetet. Alla dina uppgifter sparas på ditt CV-konto och du kan enkelt logga in och uppdatera dina uppgifter när du vill. Fyll därför i dina uppgifter så omsorgsfullt som möjligt för att ge en rättvisande bild av dig själv.

Dina personuppgifter behandlas i Varbi under rekryteringsprocessen och i den utsträckning detta är nödvändigt för att uppfylla lagstiftningen. Ansökan raderas 24 månader efter avslutande av rekrytering. Om du har ett Varbi-konto kan du använda redigeringen av din profil för att radera, ladda upp och redigera information. Kontakta annars Ale kommun.

Vi vill upplysa om att din ansökan är en offentlig handling enligt offentlighetsprincipen.

  • Agenda management, organisation of meetings en events.

  • Handling calls, emails and correspondence.

  • Supporting billing processes and expense reporting.

jobs.title: Assistant Location Manager @Kortrijk
jobs.description:
Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Spring jij graag bij waar nodig is? Hou je van een job waar geen dag hetzelfde is en waar energie en actie centraal staan? Perfect!

Voor onze klant, dé marktleider in trampolineparken in België, Nederland, Duitsland en Frankrijk, zijn we op zoek naar een enthousiaste Assistant Park Manager in jouw regio.

In deze rol ben jij de spil van het park: je springt (letterlijk en figuurlijk!) van de keuken naar het onthaal, van het team naar de gasten, en van operationele taken naar creatieve uitdagingen.

Jouw missie? Ervoor zorgen dat élke bezoeker met een glimlach en vermoeide benen naar huis gaat!

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Als Assistant Park Manager ben je veel meer dan een manager achter een bureau.

Je bent overal: in de keuken, in de zaal, aan de kassa én op de werkvloer.

Je stuurt aan, denkt mee, pakt door én inspireert je team om elke dag het beste van zichzelf te geven.

Concreet betekent dat:

  • Je draait volop mee in de dagelijkse operatie: keuken, zaal, onthaal — you name it, you do it
  • Je zorgt samen met jouw team voor een 'service beyond expectations' — want tevreden gasten komen terug!
  • Je houdt het overzicht: administratie, kassabeheer, bestellingen… jij weet precies wat er speelt
  • Je beheert de voorraad met wekelijkse inventarisaties en zorgt dat er altijd voldoende stock is
  • Je regelt de personeelsadministratie en houdt alles netjes bij
  • Je coacht en motiveert je team, en begeleidt nieuwe collega's tijdens hun eerste stappen
  • Je bewaakt de kwaliteit
  • Je bedenkt gave acties en events om het park nóg populairder te maken in de buurt

Herken jij jezelf hierin?

  • Je hebt leidinggevende ervaring in leisure, horeca of retail — een diploma is leuk, maar ervaring weegt voor ons zwaarder
  • Je bent een geboren teamleider: communicatief sterk, besluitvaardig en je durft een groep jonge, energieke medewerkers aan te sturen
  • Ook als het druk is en de zaal vol zit, blijf jij glimlachen en straal je pure klantvriendelijkheid uit
  • Hands-on is jouw second nature — je steekt zonder aarzelen zelf de handen uit de mouwen
  • Structuur en organisatie zitten in je DNA, en zelfstandig werken is geen enkel probleem
  • Je denkt commercieel en ziet omzet als een leuke uitdaging in plaats van een verplichting
  • Flexibiliteit? Check! Vroege diensten, late shifts, weekenden — maakt je allemaal niets uit
  • Je woont in de buurt van de vestiging waarvoor je solliciteert

ANIOS Bedrijfsgeneeskunde | Regio Zwolle

06-30087839
d.viswat@corparis.nl
Ben jij toe aan een volgende stap als arts en wil je ontdekken wat de bedrijfsgeneeskunde jou te bieden heeft? Dan hebben wij een interessante uitdaging voor je.
De wereld van de geneeskunde reikt verder dan het ziekenhuis. Binnen de bedrijfsgeneeskunde richt je je op de relatie tussen gezondheid, werk en duurzame inzetbaarheid. Als ANIOS Bedrijfsgeneeskunde speel je een belangrijke rol in het begeleiden van werknemers en werkgevers bij vraagstukken rondom gezondheid, verzuim en re-integratie.
Je voert spreekuren, beoordeelt medische situaties en adviseert over een verantwoorde terugkeer naar werk. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de medische klachten, maar ook naar de invloed van werk, leefstijl en persoonlijke omstandigheden op het herstelproces. Je denkt actief mee over duurzame oplossingen en ondersteunt werknemers bij het behouden of hervatten van hun werkzaamheden.
Daarnaast houd je je bezig met preventieve vraagstukken, positieve gezondheid, medische keuringen en duurzame inzetbaarheid. Geen dag is hetzelfde: je hebt contact met werknemers, werkgevers en andere professionals binnen de arbodienstverlening, waardoor je een brede medische en adviserende rol vervult.
Voor deze functie treed je in dienst bij Corparis en word je gedetacheerd bij een organisatie binnen de arbodienstverlening. Je werkt onder begeleiding van ervaren professionals en krijgt volop ruimte om jezelf zowel persoonlijk als vakinhoudelijk te ontwikkelen.
Om jou een vliegende start te geven binnen de bedrijfsgeneeskunde biedt Corparis een uitgebreid ontwikkelprogramma. Je krijgt onder andere toegang tot trainingen zoals Vitaliteit in de Spreekkamer , Aanhoudende Lichamelijke Klachten (ALK) en Motiverende Gespreksvoering . Daarnaast kun je je verder...

jobs.title: Experienced Junior Graphic Designer - Scale-up company
jobs.description:
Monday Merch produces physical branded merchandise and custom apparel for international enterprise clients. Due to the high technical complexity of physical manufacturing, this role requires at least 1 year of hands-on experience specifically in merchandise, apparel, or packaging design.

A standard graphic design background is insufficient. The candidate must possess proven experience with pre-press production processes, including vectorizing artwork, Pantone (PMS) color matching, print separations for embroidery and Screen Printing/DTG, and mapping 2D artwork onto complex 3D product surfaces. Furthermore, the candidate must have experience executing designs within strict corporate B2B brand guidelines and working directly with technical specifications from global manufacturers.

About Monday Merch
Monday Merch is a fast-growing B2B merch platform based in Rotterdam. We design, produce, and deliver high-quality, sustainable custom merchandise and corporate gifts for leading global brands and scale-ups.

The Role: Graphic & Visual Designer
We are looking for a talented Graphic & Visual Designer to join our creative team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between creative visual design and physical product execution. You will be responsible for creating compelling visual assets, developing brand identities, and translating complex design concepts into production-ready physical merchandise.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop full visual identity packages, brand guidelines, and high-impact design assets.
Create production-ready vector files and technical specs (tech packs, CMYK/Pantone prepress) for apparel, accessories, and custom packaging.
Lead design projects from initial concept and artwork creation through final supplier handoff.
Collaborate with account managers, production teams, and external suppliers to maintain visual quality across physical products.

What We Offer:
A dynamic, international work environment in Rotterdam.
Full-time position (40h/week) with market-competitive remuneration.
Catered team lunches, travel reimbursement, and high-end merch benefits.

The purpose of this position is to operate packaging or labeling machines and perform manual packaging operations according to procedures and guidelines, so that orders are packaged according to the standard and on time are available for shipping. Works with moderate work direction and is skilled and knowledgeable to the position.

Main responsibilities:
Visually inspect vaccines.
Assist colleagues/teams when necessary.
Work according to filling instructions and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) guidelines.
Prioritize safety by actively contributing to a safe working environment.
Participate in improvement projects and activities, both independently and as part of a team.

Requirements:
Completed education at a minimum MBO level 2.
Technical knowledge and/or an interest in technical work.
Experience with and knowledge of GMP and GDP.
A professional attitude, combined with enthusiasm and a willingness to learn.
Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues.
Someone eager and motivated to help improve our department.

Our client is a global leader in medicines, dedicated to creating a healthy world. Through their vaccines, biologics, and medicines, they provide innovative treatments to improve the health of people and animals in more than 140 countries. They focus on conditions that severely impair daily functioning or are life-threatening, and for which new medicines are needed. Our client is also a pioneer in biologics research and development for animal health.

At our client, they believe in the power of diversity within teams of talented employees at all levels. Diverse skills, experiences, backgrounds, and cultural perspectives help them better understand the needs of their diverse customers, healthcare providers, and patients. Our client employs approximately 4,500 people across three locations in the Netherlands.

jobs.title: Uitvoerder Infra
jobs.description:
Als Uitvoerder Infra ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van infrastructurele projecten. Je bewaakt de voortgang en zorgt dat werkzaamheden veilig, efficiënt en volgens afspraak worden uitgevoerd.
Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:
• Je stuurt medewerkers, onderaannemers en leveranciers aan, zodat werkzaamheden volgens planning verlopen.
• Je bewaakt de voortgang van projecten, waarbij je continu kijkt naar kwaliteit, veiligheid en rendement.
• Je stemt dagelijks af met werkvoorbereiding en projectleiding, zodat alle betrokken partijen beschikken over actuele projectinformatie.
• Je organiseert de inzet van personeel, materieel en materiaal, waardoor uitvoerende teams optimaal kunnen presteren.
• Je onderhoudt contact met opdrachtgevers, toezichthouders en andere stakeholders, zodat verwachtingen helder blijven.
• Je ziet toe op naleving van veiligheidsvoorschriften en kwaliteitsnormen, zodat projecten voldoen aan alle gestelde eisen.
• Je registreert meer- en minderwerk en houdt projectadministratie bij, zodat afwijkingen tijdig inzichtelijk zijn.
• Je signaleert risico's en knelpunten tijdens de uitvoering, waarna je direct actie onderneemt om vertragingen te voorkomen.
• Je begeleidt junior collega's en vakmensen, zodat kennis binnen het team wordt gedeeld en ontwikkeld.

Functie-eisen:
Voor deze functie zoeken we iemand die stevig in zijn schoenen staat, overzicht houdt en energie krijgt van het realiseren van mooie projecten.
Daarnaast zien we graag het volgende terug:
• Een afgeronde MBO- of HBO-opleiding richting Civiele Techniek, GWW of vergelijkbaar.
• Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als uitvoerder, assistent-uitvoerder of voorman binnen de infra.
• Ervaring met grond-, weg- en waterbouwprojecten.
• Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en natuurlijk leiderschap.
• Een praktische instelling en oplossingsgerichte aanpak.
• Kennis van veiligheid, kwaliteit en uitvoeringsprocessen.
• VCA-VOL of bereidheid deze te behalen.
• Rijbewijs B.

De NVWA-IOD komt in actie bij ernstige misdrijven op de verschillende publieke belangen van de NVWA. Hierbij kun je denken aan het op de markt brengen van producten die gevaar op kunnen leveren voor de volksgezondheid, het vervalsen van de herkomst van vlees, het illegaal slachten van dieren, het verhandelen van illegale afslankmiddelen, het frauderen met meststromen of het verhandelen van illegale en schadelijke gewasbeschermingsmiddelen. Nieuwsgierig naar het soort onderzoeken dat de NVWA-IOD uitvoert? Luister dan de podcast 'Roet in het Eten', voor een uniek kijkje achter de schermen.
Wij zoeken een nieuwe senior tactisch rechercheur voor team Centraal in Wageningen. Het team gaat in 2027 naar verwachting verplaatsen naar Veenendaal.
Als senior tactisch rechercheur ben je algemeen opsporingsambtenaar en voer je samen met collega's in teamverband deze opsporingsonderzoeken uit. Hierbij doe je aan waarheidsvinding bij onderzoek naar misdrijven door personen en bedrijven die binnen het NVWA domein actief zijn.
Als rechercheur houdt je je onder meer bezig met onderzoek naar in beslag genomen (digitale) administraties van bedrijven, het uitluisteren van telefoontaps, het analyseren van onderzoeksgegevens en de observatie van bedrijven en verdachten. Ook de inzet van verschillende verhoortechnieken en het voorbereiden en uitvoeren van doorzoekingen behoren tot je werkzaamheden. Als senior tactisch rechercheur ben je ervaringsdeskundige en houdt je toezicht op deze processen. Hierbij vervul je een coördinerende en sturende rol.
Naast de rol als vervanger van de onderzoeksleider, zal je in deze senior functie, tevens deelfacetten van het opsporingsonderzoek zelfstandig uitvoeren. Het betreft ook het aansturen, motiveren en coachen van de verschillende functionarissen binnen het onderzoeksteam. Het Bedrijf
Wij zijn een bouwbedrijf met 60 collega's en werken aan grote utilitaire projecten zoals scholen, zorggebouwen en sporthallen. Dat zijn projecten waar veel disciplines tegelijk werken en waar planning heel belangrijk is. Laatst hebben we een compleet schoolcomplex gebouwd met meerdere gebouwen en sportvoorzieningen. Op de bouw lopen verschillende teams door elkaar heen en alles moet goed op elkaar aansluiten. We werken gestructureerd, want zonder duidelijke planning gaat zo'n groot project niet goed.

Je start de dag op een groot project waar meerdere teams tegelijk bezig zijn. Jij werkt aan onderdelen van de bouw zoals vloeren, wanden of ondersteunende constructies. jobs.title: Bussförare i Tromsø - Norge
jobs.description:
Är du redo för ett nytt äventyr i Tromsø? Bli en del av Tide och bidra till trygga och hållbara reseupplevelser varje dag.

Vill du kombinera ett tryggt jobb med spektakulär natur och oförglömliga upplevelser?
Tide söker både tillsvidareanställda och säsongsanställda bussförare (3-12 månader) till Tromsø, en av Nordens mest unika städer. Här får du möjligheten att arbeta i en professionell och inkluderande arbetsmiljö samtidigt som du får uppleva midnattssol, norrsken och fantastiska möjligheter till friluftsliv.

Som bussförare hos oss spelar du en viktig roll i vardagen för tusentals människor. Varje dag ser du till att våra passagerare kommer fram tryggt och säkert, samtidigt som du bidrar till ett mer hållbart samhälle.

Därför väljer många Tide:
- Fast och trygg anställning hos ett av Norges största bussbolag
- Konkurrenskraftig lön enligt kollektivavtal
- Gedigen introduktion och stöd från erfarna kollegor
- Hjälp genom hela processen med förarkort/körtillstånd
- Möjlighet till tillfälligt boende vid anställningsstart
- En trivsam arbetsmiljö med fokus på samarbete och arbetsglädje

Varför Tromsø?
Tromsø kallas ofta för Nordens Paris och erbjuder en unik kombination av stadsliv och storslagen natur.
- Upplev norrskenet under vintern
- Njut av midnattssolen på sommaren
- Åk skidor och gör toppturer precis utanför staden
- Paddla kajak, fiska och upptäck fantastisk natur året runt
- Ta del av ett rikt kulturliv med festivaler, konserter och evenemang

Vi söker dig som har:
- Körkort klass D
- YKB (Yrkeskompetensbevis)
- Körtillstånd för persontransport eller möjlighet att ansöka om detta (Tide kan hjälpa till)
- För att kunna kommunicera väl med passagerare, kollegor och trafikledningen måste du behärska norska, svenska eller engelska på minst B2-nivå.
- Ett tryggt, serviceinriktat och behagligt körsätt

Lön och villkor:
Tide följer Bussbranschavtalet (kollektivavtal).

Genomsnittslönen för bussförare ligger på omkring 603 000 norska kronor per år, beroende på anställningstid, yrkesbevis, kompetens och olika lönetillägg. Utöver grundlönen tillkommer bland annat kvälls-, helg- och skifttillägg samt eventuell övertidsersättning.

Boende vid anställningsstart:
Vi hjälper dig med boende under uppstartsfasen. Under de första sex månaderna står Tide för hyran i ett av våra rum eller lägenheter.

Om du vill bo kvar efter denna period kan du hyra bostaden vidare på egen bekostnad.

Söker du eget boende kan vi även hjälpa till med hyresgaranti, referenser och praktiskt stöd i bostadssökandet.

Vi hjälper dig med körtillstånd:
För att arbeta som bussförare i Norge behöver du ett norskt körtillstånd för persontransport.

Tide vägleder dig genom hela processen, inklusive ansökan, läkarintyg och nödvändig dokumentation. Handläggningstiden hos polisen är normalt mellan 2 och 6 veckor, därför rekommenderar vi att du påbörjar processen så tidigt som möjligt.

Du hittar mer information här: https://jobb.tide.no/jobs/8337235-bussforare-i-tromso-upplev-nordens-paris

In English:
Ready for a New Adventure in Tromsø? Join Tide and help create safe, sustainable, and enjoyable travel experiences every day.

Would you like to combine a secure job with spectacular nature and exciting experiences?
Tide is looking for both permanent and seasonal bus drivers (3-12 months) for Tromsø, one of the most unique cities in Northern Norway.

Here, you will have the opportunity to work in a professional and inclusive environment while experiencing the Midnight Sun, the Northern Lights, and fantastic outdoor activities.

As a bus driver with us, you play an important role in the daily lives of thousands of people. Every day, you ensure that passengers reach their destinations safely while contributing to a more sustainable society.

Why Choose Tide:
- Permanent and secure employment with one of Norway's largest bus companies
- Competitive salary through a collective bargaining agreement
- Comprehensive training and support from experienced colleagues
- Assistance with the passenger transport licence application process
- Opportunity for temporary accommodation upon relocation
- A positive working environment focused on well-being and teamwork

We Are Looking for Someone Who Has:
- Category D driving licence
- CPC (Certificate of Professional Competence) / YSK for bus drivers
- A Passenger Transport Licence (Kjøreseddel) or eligibility to apply for one (Tide can assist)
- To communicate effectively with passengers, colleagues, and the traffic control centre, you must have Norwegian, Swedish, or English language skills at a minimum B2 level
- A safe, service-oriented, and comfortable driving style

Salary and Working Hours:
Tide follows the Norwegian Bus Industry Collective Agreement.

The average annual salary for bus drivers is approximately NOK 603,000, depending on seniority, vocational qualifications, competence, and additional allowances.

The bus industry offers various supplements, including shift allowances, evening and weekend premiums, as well as overtime pay. Salary will vary depending on the shifts worked.

Working hours may include split shifts and work at different times of the day, including weekends and public holidays. Overtime pay and other supplements are regulated by the collective agreement.

Accommodation When You Start:
We help you with accommodation during your start-up period. For the first six months, Tide covers the rent for one of our rooms or apartments.

After this period, you may choose to remain in the accommodation and continue renting at your own expense. Monthly rent typically ranges from approximately NOK 8,000 to NOK 11,000, depending on the property.

If you prefer to find your own accommodation, we can also assist with a rental deposit guarantee, references, and practical support during your housing search.

We Help You Obtain Your Passenger Transport Licence:
To work as a bus driver in Norway, you must hold a Norwegian Passenger Transport Licence (Kjøreseddel).

Tide can guide you through the entire process, including the application, medical certificate, and required documentation. Processing times with the police are normally between 2 and 6 weeks, so we recommend starting the process as early as possible.

For more information, please visit: https://jobb.tide.no/en-GB/jobs/8337402-bus-driver-in-tromso

jobs.title: LeHibou - Information Security Engineer
jobs.description:
An international technology company operating in the media sector is looking for an Information Security Engineer to join the IT Security team within the corporate IT department. The role focuses on operational cybersecurity activities, vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident response support, security assessments, and continuous improvement of security controls.
This is a hands-on role combining technical expertise, operational follow-up, coordination, and continuous improvement. The position is part of a structured cybersecurity and compliance programme in the context of NIS2 obligations under Belgian law and the implementation of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification, with a target of April 2027. The consultant/employee will contribute directly to control implementation, evidence production, and audit readiness across the corporate IT perimeter.

Practical information

  • Location: Seraing (Liège), Belgium
  • Contract type: open to freelance consultant or permanent employee, depending on profile
  • Start date: as soon as possible
  • Remote work: hybrid model with 2 days per week remote and 3 days on site
  • Travel: no travel required
  • Reporting line: Cybersec Operations Manager
  • Working language: French for day-to-day team interactions, with professional English required for documentation, tools, and international stakeholders
  • Team context: the IT Security team is being structured and scaled, in a build environment rather than a steady-state operation

Main responsibilities

Security operations & monitoring:
  • Monitor and investigate security alerts across multiple security platforms
  • Participate in incident response activities and support the coordination of security investigations
  • Improve and tune detection capabilities and monitoring use cases
  • Support the development and maintenance of operational security procedures and playbooks
  • Perform operational security reviews and follow-up activities

Vulnerability & exposure management:
  • Coordinate vulnerability scanning activities and ensure findings are reviewed and prioritized
  • Follow up remediation actions with infrastructure, platform, application, and support teams
  • Track remediation progress and escalate overdue actions when required
  • Coordinate external penetration tests and security assessments
  • Ensure findings from assessments and pentests are documented, tracked, and remediated

Security assessments & risk management:
  • Perform security reviews of applications, services, and technical solutions
  • Contribute to risk assessments for new projects, technologies, and providers
  • Review security configurations and identify improvement opportunities
  • Support the identification and management of security risks across the IT environment

Security governance & reporting:
  • Maintain and monitor operational security KPIs and dashboards
  • Support reporting related to vulnerabilities, incidents, security posture, and remediation efforts
  • Participate in periodic reviews of user access, privileged accounts, and security controls
  • Contribute to compliance activities and implementation of security requirements related to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and NIS2
  • Produce and maintain auditable evidence of security control operations, including logs, reports, review records, and remediation closure evidence

Security improvement & automation:
  • Identify opportunities to improve security controls and operational processes
  • Contribute to...
... Experience:
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, vulnerability management, or a related technical security role
  • Experience in security monitoring, incident handling, or vulnerability management
  • Experience working with security tools and operational security processes

Technical knowledge:
  • Understanding of security monitoring and incident response principles
  • Knowledge of vulnerability management processes and risk-based remediation prioritization, including CVSS scores, asset criticality, exploitability context, and compensating controls
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender XDR suite: Defender for EndPoint, Defender for Office 365 / Exchange Online Protection, and Defender for Identity
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Sentinel or an equivalent SIEM platform; deployment experience is a strong asset
  • Understanding of Entra ID governance, including Conditional Access, Identity Protection, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM)
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Purview
  • Understanding of network security fundamentals, including Firewall management with Palo Alto or FortiGate, log forwarding, and network segmentation principles

Personal skills:

jobs.title: Business Controller – Reporting, Analyse & Business Partnering
jobs.description:
En tant que Business Controller, vous rejoignez une équipe Finance d’une dizaine de collaborateurs spécialisés en comptabilité et en contrôle de gestion. Vous soutenez la direction dans ses décisions stratégiques et financières en produisant des analyses et des informations fiables.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les différents départements de l’entreprise et rapportez directement au Finance Manager. Source : offre officielle publiée sur LinkedIn.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Préparer les reportings financiers périodiques.
  • Collecter les informations financières auprès des différents départements.
  • Consolider les données nécessaires au reporting.
  • Contrôler la fiabilité et la cohérence des informations communiquées.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes opérationnelles et la direction.
  • Agir comme partenaire financier des différents départements.
  • Challenger les données, hypothèses et informations transmises.
  • Réaliser des analyses financières détaillées.
  • Analyser les performances financières et opérationnelles.
  • Identifier les écarts, tendances, risques et opportunités.
  • Expliquer les résultats financiers aux différentes parties prenantes.
  • Formuler des recommandations pour soutenir la prise de décision.
  • Répondre aux demandes d’analyse ponctuelles du business et du groupe.
  • Participer à l’élaboration des budgets.
  • Contribuer à la préparation des forecasts mensuels.
  • Collaborer avec les départements concernés pendant les exercices de planification.
  • Suivre les résultats par rapport aux budgets et aux prévisions.
  • Participer activement aux audits internes.
  • Soutenir les audits externes.
  • Préparer et mettre à disposition les informations demandées par les auditeurs.
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des procédures financières.
  • Identifier les possibilités d’optimisation des outils existants.
  • Participer à l’automatisation et à l’amélioration de l’efficacité des processus.
  • Présenter les analyses et résultats au Finance Manager.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Sales, Marketing, Développement et les autres unités internes.
  • Vous disposez d’une formation supérieure en Finance, Économie ou dans une orientation comparable.
  • Vous possédez au minimum cinq années d’expérience professionnelle pertinente.

jobs.title: Verpleegkundige operatiekwartier: NKO, neurochirurgie en MKA
jobs.description:
Het operatiekwartier van het UZA bestaat uit zes clusters, die gespecialiseerd zijn in verschillende medische ingrepen. In totaal tellen we 19 hoogtechnologische operatiezalen, waarmee we een van de grootste OK’s in Antwerpen zijn. Omdat we blijven groeien, zoeken we voor cluster 1 (neurochirurgie, neus-keel-oorziekten (NKO), mond-kaak-en aangezichtschirurgie (MKA)) verpleegkundigen om het perioperatieve proces te ondersteunen. Kenmerkend voor deze dienst is het belangrijke aandeel pediatrische patiënten en robotchirurgie.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je assisteert bij verschillende NKO-, MKA- en neurochirurgische ingrepen als instrumenterend verpleegkundige of omloopverpleegkundige:
    • Instrumenteren? Da’s vooraf materialen klaarleggen en de patiënten voorbereiden op de operatie. Tijdens de ingreep geef je aan de chirurg de nodige instrumenten aan.
    • Omlopen? Dan ondersteun je jouw collega-verpleegkundige die instrumenteert. Zo help je om de patiënt goed te positioneren, het chirurgisch team zich steriel aan te kleden. Verder assisteer je de anesthesist. Na afloop ruim je op en bied je nazorg aan je patiënten.
  • Je krijgt hiervoor een ruim opleidingstraject op maat: een algemeen deel voor alle OK-verpleegkundigen en een specifiek deel voor de specialiteiten binnen jouw gekozen cluster. Onze mentoren nemen je onder hun vleugels.

Onze collega Lennert vertelt je er graag meer over! (https://uzajobs.be/momenten/verpleegkundige-lennert-vertelt-je-meer-over-zijn-job-op-het-operatiekwartier)

Of volg een dag in het spoor van Louise (https://www.facebook.com/UniversitairZiekenhuisAntwerpen/videos/213602991830264)

Wie zoeken we?

  • Je hebt een diploma verpleegkunde (bachelor, master of HBO5).
  • Je werkt graag intensief samen met je collega’s. Een OK-team bestaat onder meer uit chirurgen, anesthesisten, verpleegkundigen en logistiek medewerkers. Samen vormen ze een goed geoliede machine, binnen en buiten de operatiezaal.
  • Je kan goed overweg met kinderen.
  • Je bent bereid te leren en op regelmatige basis bijscholingen te volgen.
  • Nadat je ons opleidingstraject afrondt, neem je ook deel aan het volcontinu systeem met thuiswachten.

jobs.title: Begeleid(st)er klasse 1 Asse/Anderlecht (m/v/x)
jobs.description:
Werken als contextbegeleider binnen De Loper vzw, wat houdt dat in?

Wij zijn een dynamische organisatie met een sterke visie. Je komt terecht in een warm en betrokken team. Werken als contextbegeleider betekent dat je een directe impact hebt op het leven van de cliënten. Je gaat samen met hen op weg en reikt hen tools en middelen aan die hen echt vooruit kunnen helpen. Het is zeer afwisselend werk waarbij je steeds zoekt naar de meest aangewezen manier van handelen.

Onze visie op hulpverlening:

De hulpverlening is een interactief en contextueel gegeven waarin de cliënt in eerste instantie de expert is van de eigen beleving van de problematiek. De hulpverlening kan pas slagen als de eigen mogelijkheden van de cliënt geactiveerd en hersteld kunnen worden. De begeleiding steunt op een partnerschap tussen enerzijds de voorziening en anderzijds de cliënt.

Dit houdt in dat de cliënt recht heeft op goede hulpverlening die aangepast is aan de persoonlijkheid, de problematiek en de omgevingselementen

Concreet ben je dus verantwoordelijk voor de opvolging van een aantal cliënten die naar ons doorverwezen worden door bijv het OCJ.

Een greep uit je takenpakket:

· Opstellen handelingsplan

· Deelnemen aan overlegvergaderingen, zowel intern als extern

· Vaste permanentiedag

· Bijscholen

· Verbindend werken

Gewenst profiel:

Krijg je energie van mensen helpen? Ben je bereid om bijscholingen te volgen (bijvoorbeeld Signs of Safety)? Ben je flexibel en kan je out of the box denken?

Dan zijn wij misschien wel op zoek naar jou!

Gevraagde diploma’s: Bachelors of Masters in sociale/pedagogische/psychologische richtingen.

Ook als je binnenkort afstudeert, en deze job lijkt je wel iets, mag je zeker al solliciteren.

Enkele bijkomende voorwaarden:

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed en je kan je minstens behelpen in het Frans

· Je hebt kennis van Word, Exel en aanverwanten

· Je woont maximum 20km van de werkplek verwijderd (1070 Anderlecht of 1730 Asse)

· Je kan een attest van goed gedrag en zeden (type 2 ) voorleggen van minder dan 2 maanden geleden
