jobs.title: Audit Data & AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Role Summary

TRATON Financial Services’ Internal Audit department is looking for an Audit Data & AI Solutions Engineer to help build the next generation of audit technology.

Internal Audit is the third line of defense. We look for things others may have missed — the proverbial needle in the haystack. Our role is to assess whether controls designed to prevent mistakes, fraud, inefficiency, and regulatory breaches are actually working in practice.

For several years, we have successfully used source-system data, analytics, and dashboards to make audits more targeted and data-driven. Building on that foundation, we are now expanding into AI-enabled audit technology: automating parts of audit sample testing by drawing evidence-based conclusions from documents in multiple languages, identifying unusual assets or transactions, and building dashboards and applications that help auditors focus on what matters most.

You will be part of a small team within Internal Audit that builds the solutions to make this happen. The work spans hands-on data mapping, source-system analysis, Power BI or HTML dashboards, anomaly detection, machine learning, and agentic AI solutions for audit sample testing and document review.

This creates both opportunities and challenges. We can move quickly, test ideas, and learn through short feedback loops with auditors. At the same time, we do not have large predefined frameworks, methods, or roadmaps. We need people who enjoy building things in complex environments, can operate between data, software, AI, and business processes, and can create solutions that are structured, documented, trustworthy, and sustainable.

Job Responsibilities

As Audit Data & AI Solutions Engineer, you will build and maintain data, analytics, automation, and AI solutions that help Internal Audit assess controls and identify anomalies. That includes:

    Retrieving, mapping, validating, and structuring data from source systems across brands and markets
    Building analytics and algorithms to identify anomalies, control weaknesses, unusual transactions, approval issues, collateral risks, or financial crime indicators
    Developing AI-enabled and agentic solutions for document analysis and audit sample testing, including prompts, skills, tools, agent workflows, evaluation logic, and evidence-based outputs
    Creating Power BI, HTML, or other dashboards that present complex findings in a clear and useful way
    Ensuring that algorithms, prompts, data flows, and assumptions are documented and built in a modular way so they can be reused.

Who you are:

We are looking for a fast learner and hands-on builder who has:

    Strong Python and SQL skills
    Comfort using AI tools and coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, or similar to write, test, debug, and improve code
    Curiosity to understand business processes, controls, audit logic, and what makes an analysis useful in practice
    The ability to turn unclear business problems into working, tested, and maintainable solutions
    Experience building practical technical solutions such as scripts, data tools, dashboards, applications, automations, or analytics workflows
    Strong analytical and debugging skills, including the ability to investigate data quality issues, logic errors, and unexpected results
    A structured approach to documentation, testing, version control, and reusable code
    Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

It is an advantage if you have experience with:

    Power BI, data modelling, DAX, Power Query, or code-based Power BI development
    Machine learning, anomaly detection, exception reporting, or process monitoring
    LLM applications, document analysis, agents, RAG, prompt/context engineering, tool use, skills, OCR, JSON, APIs, or workflow applications
    Additional languages, data visualization, financial services, audit, risk, compliance, or controls.

This Is Us

At TRATON Financial Services (TFS) we have started the journey to become the provider of Financial Services to all TRATON brands. Our service includes financing for customers, dealers, and distributors as well as insurance solutions. With a presence in over 65 markets, we are already one of the most global actors in the financial services industry and are rapidly growing. Do you want to be part of this journey?

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Position in Animal Welfare Risks of Feeding Red Seaweed to Dairy Cows
jobs.description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Aarhus University, calls for applications for a full-time postdoctoral position. The two-year position is available from 1 February 2027, or soon thereafter. The position will be in the research unit Behaviour, stress and welfare (BSW).

Dairy cattle contribute substantially to agricultural greenhouse gas emissions, primarily through enteric methane production, making the identification of effective nutritional mitigation strategies an important area of research. While the feed additive Bovaer has received considerable attention for its methane-reducing effects, concerns regarding animal health and welfare have led to increasing interest in alternative solutions, including seaweed-based feed additives. The seaweed Asparagopsis spp. has shown significant methane-mitigating potential; however, its use has also raised animal welfare concerns. Consequently, there is a need to evaluate the animal welfare effects of seaweed-based feed additives.

Research tasks
  • Evaluating the effects of seaweed-based feed additives on the behaviour and welfare of dairy cattle.
  • Investigating behavioural indicators of discomfort and pain associated with feed management.
  • Validating welfare assessment measures through experimental approaches, including pharmacological interventions.
  • Contributing to scientific publications and dissemination of research results.
  • Participating in knowledge exchange activities with public authorities and industry stakeholders.
  • Contributing to teaching and supervision of students at the bachelor's, master's, and PhD levels.


Qualifications
We are seeking a candidate who has:
  • A PhD degree or equivalent in biology, animal science, veterinary science, or a related field, and research experience in animal behaviour and welfare.
  • A strong interest in strategies aimed at reducing the climate impact of dairy production through feeding management.
  • At least a basic understanding of feeding management.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate scientific research results effectively.
  • The ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a research environment.
  • For non-Scandinavian candidates, a commitment to learning Danish, including reading, writing, and speaking, is expected during the employment period.


Contact
Further information on the position may be obtained from Professor Margit Bak Jensen, phone: +4522365482, email: margitbak.jensen@anivet.au.dk

What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal experimental facilities
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities
  • A workplace characterized by equality and a good work-life balance, and an open discussion across different fields of research.


The candidate will have the opportunity to be trained and gain experience in:
  • Teaching and supervision of students at the BSc and MSc level through active involvement in teaching in animal science and in the veterinary science programme.
  • Research-based consultancy to authorities, where it is relevant.


Who we are
Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to solve essential societal challenges within the green transition: food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, environment, climate, health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for the research-based public sector consultancy and degree programs covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programs within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated in the research environment.

Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies, situated in close connection to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and good industrial and professional collaboration.

Please refer to Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (au.dk) for further information about the department: https://anivet.au.dk/en

Place of work and area of employment
The place of work is the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, AU Viborg,
Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele, and the area of employment is Aarhus University (AU) with related departments.

Living in Denmark
Please visit the international staff website: https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.



Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.



Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description:
Want to work with sustainability and software? Looking to be part of an innovative, fast-growing Danish greentech company with global reach? Then Explicit might be the place for you.

We are looking for a software developer to join us to develop and maintain our digital platforms as we scale.

We do drone-based emissions monitoring across oil & gas, maritime, waste management, and other industries. By helping operators safely identify methane leaks and quantify emissions, we're proud to be supporting industry efforts to improve environmental performance while enhancing operational efficiency and asset integrity. We measure greenhouse gas emissions data from various sources and combining them with atmospheric data. Based on scientific methods we then quantify emissions and visualize the data to provide emissions intelligence to operations enabling actions on emissions.

We have a strong focus on R&D, and we are exploring new cutting-edge technologies and ideas to innovate what we can do within emissions monitoring.

The job

You will be part of a small, talented tech developer team, responsible for designing, building and maintaining our digital platforms, which are the core of the products we deliver to customers.

As a Software Developer your responsibilities will include:

  • Co-development of our main applications Microsoft Azure, Blazor Server Application (C#)

  • Co-development of our calculation engine, Microsoft Azure Function (Python)

  • Develop new, more appealing user experiences aimed at different user groups to view products and services.

  • Maintain databases, application services and reporting landscape specific to the European maritime emission monitoring set-up.

  • Improve analysis tools and the user experience for the customers, the drone pilot and the internal project manager in collaboration with the project manager running the campaigns.

About you

We are looking for a candidate who meets the following criteria:

  • A bachelor's degree or master’s degree in engineering, data science, software design, computer engineering, mathematics, physics or similar

  • Experience with code development in C# and Python and preferable Rust

  • Experience with database design (SQL)

  • Familiar with software development processes in Azure DevOps

  • Experience with development of user interfaces and UX design is an advantage, but not a requirement

  • Fluent in English. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement

  • Genuine interest in technology and IT infrastructure

  • Structured and focused on delivering quality work and being a good team player.

 

What we offer

  • A permanent, full-time position in a fast-growing greentech company with real-world impact on cutting industrial emissions

  • Competitive benefits including paid pension, health insurance, parental leave and 6 weeks' holiday allowance

  • Software ownership early on, with senior developers to learn from

  • A flat hierarchy where ideas are heard, initiative is encouraged, and responsibility comes early

  • A supportive team that values collaboration, trust and learning

  • Job location is just north of Copenhagen in Virum, Denmark.

Application and information

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we will be evaluating applications on an ongoing basis. Application deadline is 18 October 2026. Expected start date is 1 November 2026.

Please send your application, including your motivation and what a competence you bring, together with your CV to jobs@explicit.dk. Write “Software developer” in the subject field.

If you have any questions about the job, you are welcome to contact Rasmus Ebdrup, Chief Digital Officer at reb@explicit.dk

___________________________________________________________________________________

About Explicit

Explicit ApS is a pioneering Danish green tech company specialising in drone-based emissions monitoring across the energy, maritime, waste management, and other industries. We deliver reliable, transparent and actionable emissions data to some of the largest energy companies all over the world using our patented drone-based methodology.

We are headquartered in Virum, Denmark, with offices in Norway, Germany and Australia. Our international team of around 30 colleagues brings together engineering, data and environmental expertise, united by a shared mission to make a difference in emissions monitoring. Read more about what we do at explicit.dk

jobs.title: Platform Engineer (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description:
Enjeu principal du poste

Garantir la disponibilité, la scalabilité et la sécurité des infrastructures Mailinblack tout en accélérant les cycles de déploiement grâce à l'automatisation et aux pratiques DevOps.

Vos missions :

Assurer la disponibilité et la performance de nos plateformes

* Déployer et maintenir les environnements de développement, de test et de production
* Garantir la disponibilité de nos services pour l'ensemble de nos clients
* Participer à l'amélioration continue de la résilience et de la scalabilité de nos plateformes

Automatiser et industrialiser nos infrastructures

* Développer et maintenir nos pipelines CI/CD
* Automatiser les tâches récurrentes des équipes techniques
* Déployer et faire évoluer nos infrastructures as code

Renforcer l'observabilité et la sécurité

* Faire évoluer les outils de supervision, monitoring et métrologie
* Participer à la gestion des vulnérabilités et au suivi des correctifs de sécurité
* Documenter les architectures, procédures et bonnes pratiques

À noter : Vous serez amené(e) à manipuler des informations confidentielles relatives à nos infrastructures et à nos clients. Le respect des politiques internes de sécurité est essentiel dans ce rôle.

Formation : Bac+5 en informatique, systèmes, réseaux ou équivalent.

Expérience : 3 à 5 ans minimum d'expérience sur un poste DevOps, SRE ou Ingénieur Infrastructure dans un environnement cloud.

Compétences attendues :

* Maîtrise d'au moins un Cloud Provider : Azure, AWS ou OVH
* Solide expérience Kubernetes (AKS idéalement)
* Bonne maîtrise de Terraform, Ansible et GitLab CI/CD
* Connaissances en observabilité : Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, Loki
* Bon niveau Linux (Debian / Ubuntu)
* Scripting Python et/ou Bash
* Sensibilité forte aux enjeux de cybersécurité

Qualités personnelles valorisées :

* Curiosité technique et volonté d'apprentissage continu
* Esprit d'équipe et sens du partage
* Capacité à prendre du recul face aux incidents
* Autonomie et rigueur
* Orientation amélioration continue

jobs.title: Smed/svejser søges til automotive virksomhed i Gedved
jobs.description:
Svejsning · Smedearbejde · Trailere og maskinkonverteringer – Fuldtid, fysisk tilstedeværelse, Gedved, Danmark

Er du typen, der læser en tegning, tænder for svejseapparatet og er stolt af det, der kommer ud i den anden ende? RENTEQ Automotive er en startup i vækst, og vi har brug for en dygtig smed til at svejse de trailere, rammer og dele, der indgår i hver eneste maskine, vi konverterer. Hvis du er praktisk anlagt, nysgerrig og har lyst til at sætte dit præg på noget, der virkelig betyder noget – så læs videre.

Om RENTEQ Automotive

RENTEQ Automotive er en ung dansk virksomhed med en ambition om at reducere CO₂-udledningen ved at elektrificere varebiler og entreprenørmaskiner. Vi holder til i Gedved og tager hele rejsen på os – fra ingeniørarbejde og udvikling helt frem til produktion.

Din rolle

Som vores smed vil du omsætte tegninger til de færdige dele, der går i vores produkter. Fra vores værksted i Gedved svejser og tilpasser du trailere, bærende rammer og de øvrige stålkomponenter, der udgør rygraden i vores maskinkonverteringer. Meget af materialet vil kommer fra egen cnc bukkemaskine og laserskærer.

Det her er ikke kun et samlebånd – der vil være mange forskellige projekter, og du skal kunne tænke selvstændigt. Du arbejder tæt sammen med ingeniør- og produktionsteamet, kan finde ud af bidrage til problemløsninger tidligt, og hjælper os med at bygge klogere fra gang til gang.

Dine opgaver

•     Svejse bærende rammer, chassisdele og konstruktioner – MIG og TIG afhængigt af materiale og specifikation

•     Bygge, svejse og tilpasse trailere og de øvrige dele, der indgår i konverteringen af maskinerne

•     Tilpasse og efterbearbejde svejsninger – opretning, slibning og kontrol af pasform

•     Læse og fortolke tekniske tegninger og omsætte dem til færdige dele

•     Kvalitetskontrollere eget arbejde – målkontrol, svejsekvalitet og pasform – inden det går til produktion

•     Samarbejde med ingeniørteamet om at identificere designproblemer og give praktisk feedback

•     Holde værkstedet organiseret, udstyr vedligeholdt og processer dokumenteret

•     Understøtte prototypeiterationer – forvent at der er hyppige designændringer og flere projekter kørende på én gang.


Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Har du praktisk erfaring inden for svejs/smedearbejde – det kan være fra en håndværksuddannelse, teknisk skole eller reel værkstedserfaring?

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du kan sætte kryds ved det meste af nedenstående:

•     Erfaren svejser – MIG og TIG

•     Erfaring med trailer-, chassis- eller konstruktionssvejsning er et stort plus

•     Fortrolig med almindeligt smedeværktøj – vinkelsliber, plasma-/gasskærer og opretningsværktøj

•     I stand til at læse og arbejde ud fra tekniske tegninger og 3D-modeller

•     Øje for detaljen: du måler to gange og er stolt af præcist, pænt arbejde

•     Trives i et team, hvor ingen dage er ens

•     Proaktiv – du identificerer problemer tidligt frem for at lade dem blive til andres problem

•     Dansk på højt niveau og velfungerende engelsk, da vi er et internationalt team.

Vi tilbyder

•     En central rolle i en startup i vækst, hvor dit arbejde er synligt i hvert køretøj, der forlader vores værksted

•     Et uformelt og rart team i en flad virksomhedsstruktur med variation i arbejdsdagene

•     Et sundt og attraktivt arbejdsmiljø med ordentligt svejse- og smedeudstyr

•     Reelle muligheder for at vokse med virksomheden, efterhånden som vi skalerer til fuld produktion.

Sådan søger du

Send dit CV og et par linjer om dig selv til Simon Steen Kristensen på email simon@ren-teq.com. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og inviterer relevante kandidater til en uformel første samtale – så vent ikke for længe med at tage kontakt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, inden du søger, er du meget velkommen til at skrive til os på samme adresse eller ringe på tlf. +45 21 94 21 43.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Monitoring and Anomaly Detection (Monetization)
Senior Backend Engineer - Platform Integrations (Monetization)
Miljøterapeut i medleverstilling
jobs.description:
Vår flotte avdeling i bydel Alna har behov deg, som ønsker å arbeide i medleverturnus 3/7/4/7. En nyinnflyttet beboer ser etter deg som har erfaring med autisme diagnose, men evner å se menneske bak. Du er god på å arbeide med mennesker som er selvstendige i mye, men fortsatt har behov for innramming, struktur og veiledning i dagliglivets gjøremål. Hvis du i tillegg liker å være aktiv, og vil være med å trene er dette ett stort pluss.

I Humana jobber vi ut fra visjonen om at alle har rett til et godt liv, ja alle. Hver dag gjør våre ansatte en innsats som betyr alt for menneskene vi er her for. Som miljøterapeut hos oss blir du en helt avgjørende del av løsningen for enkeltmennesker og en uunnværlig partner for det offentlige.

Hva skal til for å trives hos oss :

  • Bachelor innen helse eller pedagogikk.

  • God erfaring fra arbeid med mennesker med autismespekterforstyrrelse.

  • God relasjonskompetanse og evne til å skape trygghet og tillit.

  • Erfaring fra målrettet miljøarbeid, gjerne med PAS som rammeverk.

  • Evne til å forebygge stress og eskalering gjennom fleksibilitet og forutsigbarhet.

  • Evne til å ivareta beboers rett til selvbestemmelse og medvirkning, samtidig som nødvendig omsorg og trygghet sikres.

  • Du må ha gyldig førerkort klasse B.

Hos oss blir du en del av et faglig sterkt miljø og en bærebjelke i samfunnet vårt. Vi har et inkluderende og godt arbeidsmiljø preget av glede, med nært og stedlig lederskap. Du vil få mulighet til personlig utvikling, påvirkning av egen hverdag og interne karrieremuligheter i et av Norges største private velferdsselskaper. Vi tilbyr selvfølgelig også gode lønnsbetingelser, inkludert vernepleier/sykepleier tillegg, samt pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project in renal calcium transport
jobs.description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project in renal calcium transport

 

The laboratory of Henrik Dimke, Cardiovascular and Renal Research Unit at the Department of Molecular Medicine, University of Southern Denmark is seeking a highly motivated PhD student in the field of renal transport physiology. Particular emphasis will be placed on signalling through the calcium-sensing receptor and the regulation of renal calcium transport in transgenic models.

 

Research environment

The PhD student will join the laboratory of Professor Henrik Dimke in the Cardiovascular and Renal Research Unit. The laboratory studies epithelial ion transport and the mechanisms that maintain calcium, magnesium, and phosphate balance, with particular emphasis on renal calcium transport, the calcium-sensing receptor, claudins, and kidney stone disease. The Research Unit focuses on innovative molecular and biomedical research related to cardiovascular and renal physiology. We offer a stimulating, international research environment where English is the preferred language at meetings and seminars. You will work in the modern NytSUND building, which is directly connected to the new Odense University Hospital and provides state-of-the-art laboratory and animal facilities. You can read more about the department and institute here.

 

Project description

The project will investigate how altered calcium-sensing receptor (CASR) signalling disrupts the endocrine and renal control of calcium homeostasis. Particular attention will be given to autosomal dominant hypocalcaemia type 1, in which excessive CASR activity suppresses parathyroid hormone secretion and promotes renal calcium loss. The project will examine the signalling mechanisms linking CASR activation to renal calcium transport and whole-body calcium balance. The successful applicant will use clinically relevant genetic models, including inducible and cell-specific transgenic approaches, together with detailed physiological characterization, molecular and biochemical techniques, and imaging.

 

Qualifications

Qualified and highly motivated candidates from all nationalities are encouraged to apply. 

 

The successful applicant must have

  • A Master's degree (Danish: kandidatgrad) or another relevant degree that concludes a research-based study programme of minimum five years’ duration at an institution of higher education. If you do not have a Master's degree, the Graduate School will make an individual assessment of your academic qualifications.

  • Good oral and written English language skills

  • you must at the time of submission have documented research experience. E.g. be the author or co-author of an article in a peer-reviewed international journal (must at least be submitted) or of a published abstract from an international scientific conference, or have worked as research assistant full time for at least 6 months (after completing your masters degree). The research experience of each applicant is individually assessed by the Graduate School.

 

The successful applicant should have

  • The ability to work independently and in a structured manner. 

  • Good collaborative and interpersonal skills. 

  • Previous experience with experimental animal work or relevant molecular and biochemical techniques, such as western blotting or immunohistochemistry, is preferred but not required.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:

Professor Henrik Dimke

Department of Molecular Medicine

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

Tel. +45 65 50 83 10 E-mail: hdimke@health.sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• A letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)

• • Contact details for at least one professional reference who may be contacted during the assessment process.


Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. References will normally be contacted only for shortlisted candidates.

Further information about the PhD-program can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. 

 

Closing date: October 12th, 2026


Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

 

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order).

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

 

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

 

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Er du Helsefagarbeider og har lyst på en spennende og meningsfylt jobb på natt?
jobs.description:
Jeg er en 20 år gammel gutt som sitter i rullestol og trenger hjelp til det meste i hverdagen. Jeg søker en helsefagarbeider som kan bidra til at jeg kan leve et aktivt og mer selvstendig liv.


Hos meg vil det alltid være 2:1 på jobb og nødvendige hjelpemidler er tilgjengelig. I løpet av natten vil jeg ha behov for hjelp til stillingsendring og forflytting. Det er også behov for medisinhåndtering og det vil bli pålagt at man tar medisinkurs.


Det er viktig for kroppen min at jeg holder meg i aktivitet gjennom litt uttøying og trening, mine treningsrutiner vil du få opplæring i. Jeg øver på å kommunisere via øynene mine, og rullestolen (som er mine ben) er alltid med meg. Dette er aktuelt hvis du tar ekstravakter på dag/ettermiddag.


Jeg er glad i musikk og drar på kino av og til. Jeg holder til i Langesund og har egen leilighet i huset til familien min. Mamma er arbeidsleder i ordningen, så du vil få god opplæring av henne og av assistentene i Prima Assistanse.

Av og til drar jeg på turer/ferier innenlands og utenlands og trenger da også assistenter med meg. Reiser dekkes selvfølgelig for assistenter. Jeg er i USA en gang i året for opptrening og det er viktig med god oppfølging av treningsrutiner etter denne turen.


Jeg søker etter en Helsefagarbeider i fast nattstilling på 60%, turnus med hver 4. helg.


Ved skoleferier (høst-, jul-, vinter-, påske- og sommerferie) er det et stort behov for ekstravakter.

Ønskelig om du også kan være tilkalling ved ferie og sykdom for mine andre assistenter.


Du må ha kompetanse som Helsefagarbeider eller være sykepleier-/vernepleier-student.


Helsefagarbeidere og sykepleie/vernepleie studenter vil bli lønnet etter gjeldende tariff som Helsefagarbeider.


Fint hvis du er:

·       Initiativrik

·       God på relasjoner

·       Pålitelig

·       Fleksibel

·       Trygg på deg selv

Jeg ønsker meg stødige assistenter som ser muligheter og ikke begrensninger.


Arbeidsoppgaver hos meg vil være å bistå med personlig hygiene, gi medisiner, bistå med å snu meg på natt, lage og pakke ned mat og finne frem klær til neste dag. Må ha kontinuerlig tilsyn i løpet av hele natten.


Jeg kan tilby deg:

·       Godt arbeidsmiljø

·       Varierte arbeidsdager

·       Medisinkurs

·       God opplæring og oppfølging av arbeidsleder og Prima Assistanse

·       Lønn etter gjeldende tariff som Helsefagarbeider

·       Sosiale sammenkomster i form av julebord og sommerfest


Om dette høres spennende ut, ønsker jeg å høre ifra akkurat deg!


Søknader vurderes fortløpende.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Machine Operator / Production Worker with Operational Responsibility
jobs.description:
The position is open to EU/EEA citizens and other applicants with a valid work permit in Norway.

Hva vi ser etter

CC Tekstilservice AS is looking for a machine operator / production worker with operational responsibility for our production facility in Sande.

We are looking for someone who wants an active and varied workday and enjoys combining practical work with responsibility for workflow, quality and completion.

You will become an important part of the team that ensures clothing and other textiles are processed correctly and delivered to our customers on time and to the right quality standard.

This is an operational role with responsibility. You will work actively in production yourself while, after training, taking responsibility for parts of the production flow and being expected to take ownership of your own area of responsibility.

The position is well suited to someone with a strong work capacity, flexibility and a willingness to take responsibility.

You do not necessarily need previous experience in production or textile care. What matters most is that you are willing to learn, work efficiently and contribute positively to the team.

Who is the position suitable for?

We are looking for a positive and reliable employee who likes getting things done and is comfortable taking responsibility.

You take responsibility for your own tasks, follow them through to completion and actively contribute to a smooth production flow.

You are practical, work in a structured and accurate way, and can maintain a good pace without compromising on quality.

We are looking for someone who:

· has a strong work capacity and enjoys an active workday

· is flexible and contributes where needed

· takes responsibility and ownership of their own tasks

· works in a structured and efficient manner

· is accurate and quality-conscious

· is solution-oriented and takes initiative

· works well with others

· can handle a fast pace and varying workloads

· wants to learn and develop

· can communicate in a Scandinavian language or English and understand procedures and safety requirements

Experience from production, textile care or machine operation is an advantage, but not a requirement.

The right attitude, work ethic, sense of responsibility and ability to learn are highly valued by us.

Arbeidsoppgaver

As a machine operator / production worker, you will work hands-on and operationally in production.

The role includes operating production equipment, processing textiles and taking responsibility for parts of the daily production flow.

The main focus is the treatment of clothing and garments, while you will also handle other types of textiles.

After training, you will be responsible for part of the production flow and follow established procedures for quality, efficiency and smooth operations.

This means that you will not only carry out your own tasks, but also help ensure good workflow, correct prioritisation and that work within your area of responsibility is completed on time and to the required quality.

When needed, you will also assist with ironing and pressing clothing and textiles, as well as packing and preparing finished products.

The workday is active and physical, with varied tasks and a pace that is adapted to the production flow and the day's workload.

During busy periods, it is important that you are flexible, solution-oriented and willing to help where the need is greatest so that production runs smoothly and deliveries are completed on time.

Key responsibilities

· Take responsibility for parts of the daily production flow

· Contribute to planning, prioritising and following up production

· Operate production equipment, including dry-cleaning machines and washing machines

· Work with the treatment of clothing, garments and other textiles

· Monitor quality throughout the production process

· Ensure that tasks within your area of responsibility are completed on time and to the required quality

· Contribute to good workflow and efficient production

· Follow procedures for machinery, operations, order and quality

· Carry out basic maintenance of production equipment

· Help the department achieve its production targets

· When needed, assist with ironing, pressing, packing and preparing finished products

Vi tilbyr

Training and development opportunities:

You will receive thorough training in:

· machinery and production equipment

· washing and dry cleaning

· textile care

· stain treatment and spotting

· finishing

· quality assurance

· production flow and internal procedures

Our goal is for you, after training, to take ownership of your own area of responsibility and actively contribute to production that is efficient, well structured and delivers the required quality.

For the right person, there are also good opportunities for further professional development, including the possibility of working towards a Norwegian trade certificate (fagbrev) in textile cleaning.

We offer:

· A permanent full-time position in a stable and growing company

· An active and varied workday with responsibility

· Thorough training and good follow-up

· Well-organised working conditions

· A positive and inclusive working environment with friendly colleagues

· Opportunities for professional and personal development

· The possibility of working towards a trade certificate in textile cleaning for the right person

· Competitive terms by agreement

· Possibility of accommodation / a room by further agreement

Om arbeidsgiveren:

About CC Tekstilservice AS

CC Tekstilservice AS is a leading provider of textile services in Vestfold. We provide textile services to small and large customers in sectors including healthcare, hotels, industry and commercial businesses.

The company has 30 employees and annual turnover of approximately NOK 30 million. Our customers are located from Oslo to Skien and choose us because we deliver quality, reliability and strong professional expertise.

CC Tekstilservice AS is Eco-Lighthouse (Miljøfyrtårn) certified and works actively with environmental responsibility, quality and sustainability. We use, among other things, Nordic Swan Ecolabel products and continuously work to reduce the environmental impact of our production.

In addition, we are self-sufficient in electricity through solar panels and a battery solution.

Sande is centrally located in Vestfold, approximately 45 minutes from Oslo.

Read more about us at: www.cctekstil.no

jobs.title: Breakfast staff (waiter / dishwasher)
jobs.description:
Connecting Jobs, run by the non-profit organisation Beredskapslyftet, helps newcomers enter the Swedish job market while giving companies access to new talent.

Join Connecting Jobs, Welcome House and TENT in Göteborg on 1st of October for a recruitment event where you will have the opportunity to meet several hiring employers in one place.

Our client is part of a hotel chain in Gothenburg and is looking to strengthen its breakfast team. The hotel is looking for flexible Breakfast Staff with a strong focus on guest service, dining-room work and dishwashing. The role is suitable for someone who enjoys meeting people, can handle different guest situations and is comfortable working at a high pace.

Location: Gothenburg

Who we are looking for: Breakfast Staff – Waiter / Dishwasher

Responsibilities:- Welcome guests and provide friendly service during breakfast- Prepare the dining area before and during breakfast service- Set, clear and keep tables and guest areas clean and organised- Replenish and maintain the breakfast buffet- Wash dishes, cutlery, glasses and kitchen equipment- Keep the dishwashing area clean and organised- Work flexibly between the breakfast buffet, dining room, dishwashing area and other breakfast stations- Maintain a high service level and prioritise tasks during busy periods

jobs.title: Asiakkuuspäällikkö
jobs.description:
Haetaan henkilöstövuokrausyritykseen asiakkuuspäällikköä kasvavaan työyhteisöön.

Toivomme sinulta löytyvän infra-alan kokemusta sekä perus osaamista asiakkuuksien parista. Tulet toimeen erilaisten työyhteisön henkilöiden kanssa. Pyrit omalla työpanoksella ajamaan työyhteisöä eteenpäin ja olet valmis kouluttautumaan ja oppimaan uutta. Olet valmis ratkomaan ongelmia, etkä hätkähdä pienistä vastoinkäymisistä. Sinulla on mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omaan palkkaasi työpanoksellasi. Mahdollisuus edetä jopa eteenpäin uralla.

Suomenkielen taito välttämätön työnteon kannalta, englannin ja ruotsinkielen taito katsotaan eduksi.

Miksi juuri OXO Palvelut Oy?

Olemme uudenlainen henkilöstövuokrausyritys, jossa työntekijät eivät ole vain työntekijöitä.

Me OXOlla arvostamme jokaista työntekijää ihmisenä, eikä kukaan ole vain nimi ja numero paperilla. Pyrimme aina löytämään ratkaisun, jossa työ ja ihminen kohtaa täydellisesti toisensa.

Meidän kautta sinulla on mahdollisuus edetä uralla sekä kehittää omaa osaamistasi. Koulutamme työntekijöitämme jatkuvasti.

Oma nimetty yhteyshenkilö

Jätä hakemukset sähköpostiin, jossa kerrot itsestäsi, palkka toiveesi, työkokemuksestasi sekä mahdollisista suosittelijoista Tärkeintä, että kerrot rehellisesti osaamisestasi ja itsestäsi. Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana.

jobs.title: Konsult Strategy&
jobs.description:
By joining Strategy&, you will become part of a global team of practical strategists, committed to helping our Clients seize key opportunities by working alongside them to solve their toughest problems. We bring 100 years of strategy consulting experience combined with the unrivalled industry and functional capabilities of the PwC network.

A career at Strategy& will provide you with the opportunity to work with some of the world’s largest and most complex companies to understand their unique business issues and opportunities in an ever-changing environment. We work on strategically important and intellectually challenging projects with C-suite Clients. More specifically, we work with leading corporations and Private Equity firms on strategic topics, focused on our core platforms Capabilities-Driven Strategy, Fit for Growth and Deals Strategy. Example assignments with corporate Clients include strategic review, growth strategy, market expansion, profit/margin improvement, and operating model design. For Private Equity firms, we support with commercial due diligence, market study and PortCo value creation strategy and business plan.

What we offer

Strategy& supports your career growth by encouraging continuous learning and by providing a framework for you to acquire new skills at the right time. At Strategy&, we offer mentoring, tailored training programs, and a variety of fun and challenging learning opportunities. You will work on the most strategic topics across a wide range of different industries and have the ability to influence your staffing to align with your passion and interests. You will be surrounded with people who will not only challenge you intellectually, but also inspire and guide you, drive your ambition, and care about your personal and professional development. Our offering includes, but is not limited to the following:

    Pure play strategy consulting work within a wide range of industries
    Part of a top-tier strategy consultancy, both locally and globally
    Access to the resources and capabilities of the global PwC network
    Ability to influence Strategy&’s exciting growth journey
    Humble, friendly and open team atmosphere
    International staffing opportunities (but not a requirement)
    Steep learning curve, with a unique focus on personal and career development
    Generous employee benefits including parental leave policies
    Flexible working model to help balancing the needs of work at home

Responsibilities

We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent and are currently seeking experienced professionals of varying seniority to join our team and become part of our local growth journey.

Senior Associate – 2-5 years of relevant work experience

Senior Associates work with Clients through all stages of consulting projects by identifying major challenges, generating improvement hypotheses, structuring and performing analyses, drawing insights and identifying pragmatic solutions, and making strategic recommendations.

Senior Associates are often end-to-end responsible for a work stream within the project working as a valued and trusted contributor in both internal and Client settings. You will get the opportunity to manage Client team members and/or a team of junior consultants and you will work across a variety of industries and functional areas in a dynamic international setting.

Manager – 5 - 8 years of relevant work experience

Managers directly manage teams as engagement leaders, demonstrating strong project and people management skills. Managers are responsible for driving overall project progress, solving complex Client and business issues, and handling stakeholder communication both internally and externally. They hone their Client management skills as the day-to-day relationship owner, and have the opportunity to coach junior consultants on projects, learning to lead high performing teams

Preferred skills across Senior Associate and Manager candidates

    Strong business acumen and ability to quickly grasp complex problems in a diverse range of industries
    Advanced analytical capabilities with both quantitative and qualitative problem-solving skills
    Exceptional leadership qualities in managing teams, driving change, and collaboratively achieving ambitious goals
    High professional integrity and good relationship builder
    Highly motivated, with a strong personal drive and ambition
    Excellent communication and presentation skills
    Entrepreneurial spirit and a keen interest in contributing to a growing team
    Outstanding academic record from a top-tier academic institution

Application instructions

To apply, please submit a complete application with:

    CV
    Cover letter
    Academic grade transcripts

The interview process usually consists of multiple stages and various types of interviews, where you get to meet multiple members of the Strategy& Stockholm team.

We invite candidates to interviews continuously, and we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Algal Microbiome Engineering
jobs.employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
The position

At the Norwegian College of Fishery Science, Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) at UiT The Arctic University of Norway, there is a vacant position as a postdoctoral researcher affiliated with the Microalgae & Microbiomes Research Group. The position is for a fixed term of 3 years. It is a prerequisite that the applicant can carry out the project over the full course of the employment period. No person may hold more than one fixed term position as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the same institution.

The postdoctoral project focuses on programmable marine microbiomes and mechanistic interactions within the diatom phycosphere, with particular emphasis on synthetic biology, microbial ecology, and molecular interactions between marine microalgae and associated bacteria. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of experimental model systems for studying metabolite exchange, microbial community interactions, and engineered microbial consortia in marine environments.

The position is affiliated with ongoing research activities in marine microbiology, synthetic biology, and systems biology at UiT. The research combines microbiology, molecular biology, microbial cultivation, genome-informed molecular ecology, synthetic biology, and multi-omics approaches to better understand and engineer marine microbial ecosystems relevant to carbon cycling and marine biotechnology.

As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow, you will have the opportunity to advance your scientific career and further qualify for academic positions. If you do not already have the educational competence that meets the requirements for an Associate Professor position in Norway, UiT will arrange such competence during the employment period.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.


The project/position's field of research

The postdoctoral researcher will develop and apply experimental approaches for studying mechanistic interactions between marine microalgae and associated bacterial communities within the diatom phycosphere. The project will focus on the development of programmable and experimentally tractable microbial model systems using synthetic biology, microbial cultivation, and molecular biology approaches.

The successful candidate will work with cultivation and engineering of marine bacteria and microalgae, construction of synthetic microbial consortia, and investigation of microbial metabolite exchange relevant to nutrient cycling and carbon fixation in marine ecosystems. The project may also involve transcriptomics, genomics, metabolomics, and bioinformatics analyses to investigate molecular interactions between diatoms and associated microorganisms.

The position is part of a broader research program focused on programmable marine microbiomes, marine microbial ecology, and biotechnology applications relevant to climate resilience, sustainable aquaculture, and marine carbon cycling. The postdoctoral researcher will work in an interdisciplinary and international research environment and is expected to contribute actively to scientific publications, collaborative research activities, and external funding development.

You must submit a project proposal (max 2 pages) that describes how you scientifically can contribute to designing diatom phycosphere communities through the uses of engineered genetic circuits or other synthetic biology tools. The proposal should include your view on the state-of-the-art and opportunities for achievable but ground-breaking science with regards to engineering microbial consortia and non-traditional synthetic biology hosts. The proposal must include a progress plan.


Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Group Leader Hans Christopher Bernstein:

  • email: hans.c.bernstein@uit.no 

 or the Head of Department Bjørn Petter Finstad: 

  • email: bjornpetter.finstad@uit.no 

Qualifications

Required qualifications: 

  • A Norwegian doctoral degree or an equivalent foreign doctoral degree recognized as equivalent to a Norwegian PhD in microbiology, molecular biology, biotechnology, synthetic biology, marine biology, microbial ecology, systems biology, chemical engineering, bioengineering, or another relevant discipline. If you're in the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply for the position, provided that you submit parts of your dissertation along with your application. This enables the evaluation committee to assess the quality and likelihood of completion by the desired employment date. You must include a statement from your supervisor or institution stating the expected completion date for your PhD degree. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.
  • Excellent written and oral English language skills. Nordic applicants can document their capabilities by attaching their high school diploma.
  • Documented experience in experimental microbiology, molecular biology, and scientific publishing, including publication of research in peer reviewed international journals. Experience in one or more of the following areas is required:
    • synthetic biology
    • microbial cultivation
    • marine microbiology or marine microbial ecology
    • microalgae research
    • molecular cloning and genetic engineering
    • microbial ecology
    • microbial co-cultivation systems

Desired qualifications: 

  • Experience working with non-model microorganisms and/or developing molecular tools for environmental microorganisms is considered particularly advantageous.
  • Experience with one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:
    • microbial genomics, transcriptomics, or metagenomics
    • bioinformatics and analysis of omics datasets
    • metabolomics or analytical chemistry
    • microbial community analysis
    • programming/scripting in R, Python, or similar languages
    • systems biology or computational biology
  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language or willingness to learn Norwegian is considered an advantage.

The successful candidate must be able to work independently and as part of an interdisciplinary research team. Emphasis will also be placed on motivation, potential for research, scientific creativity, organizational skills, communication abilities, and personal suitability for the position.

In the assessment the main emphasis will be attached to the submitted works and the project proposal for the qualifying work. Emphasis shall also be attached to experience from popularization/dissemination and academic policy and administrative activity.

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).


Inclusion and diversity  

UiT The Arctic University i Norway is working actively to promote equality, gender balance and diversity among employees and students, and to create an inclusive and safe working environment. We believe that inclusion and diversity is a strength, and we want employees with different competencies, professional experience, life experience and perspectives.  

If you have a disability, a gap in your CV or immigrant background, we encourage you to tick the box for this in your application. If there are qualified applicants, we invite least one in each group for an interview. If you get the job, we will adapt the working conditions if you need it. Apart from selecting the right candidates, we will only use the information for anonymous statistics. 


We offer
  • Involvement in an interesting research project 
  • Good career opportunities 
  • A good academic environment with dedicated colleagues  
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement  
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

More practical information for working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility 


Application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information submitted by the application deadline via Jobbnorge. It is therefore important that you include all necessary documents demonstrating your qualifications for the position.

Your application must include:

  • Application letter
  • Project proposal (max 2 pages)
  • CV
  • Diplomas and transcripts (all degrees)
  • Documentation of English proficiency
  • Contact information to 2-3 references
  • Documentation of educational competence, if available
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important
  • The academic works (published or not) you wish us to take into consideration in the assessment

If you're in the final stages of your PhD, you may still apply for the position, provided that you submit parts of your dissertation along with your application. This enables the evaluation committee to assess the quality and likelihood of completion by the desired employment date. You must include a statement from your supervisor or institution stating the expected completion date for your PhD degree. Documentation of your completed PhD degree must be submitted before commencement.

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. If English proficiency is not documented in the application, it must be documented before starting in the position. 


Assessment

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications based on the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description draw up for the position. A copy of the assessment report will be sent to all applicants. 

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview should among other things, aim to clarify the applicant’s motivation and personal suitability for the position. A trial lecture may also be held.


General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants. 

The remuneration for Postdoctoral research fellow is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1352 with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 650'-760' (in a 100% position). (In special cases, a higher salary may be considered.) A compulsory contribution of 2 % to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund will be deducted. You will become a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, which gives you many benefits in addition to a lifelong pension. Read more about your employee benefits at: spk.no.

The successful candidate must be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

UiT wishes to promote gender equality. If two or more applicants are found to be equally qualified, the university will rank applicants from the underrepresented gender ahead of others.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is a multi-campus research university and the northernmost university of the world. Our central location in the High North, our broad and diverse research and study portfolio, and our interdisciplinary qualities make us uniquely suited to meet the challenges of the future. At UiT you can explore global issues from a close-up perspective.

Credibility, academic freedom, closeness, creativity and commitment shall be hallmarks of the relationship between our employees, between our employees and our students and between UiT and our partners. 

The Faculty of Biosciences, Fisheries and Economics (BFE) consists of Department of Arctic and Marine Biology, Norwegian College of Fishery Science (NFH) and School of Business and Economics.The main task of BFE is to conduct teaching and research dissemination at a high national and international level within all relevant fields. Prioritized research areas are aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems, climate, life in the arctic, marine bioprospecting, fish health, seafood products, business and macroeconomics, resources and environment, markets and management of marine resources. The interdisciplinary profile of the faculty provides good opportunity to develop research projects involving several research groups at the faculty according to its strategy.

jobs.title: Hyggelig dame søker fast BPA-assistent 9 timer i uken, nær Oslo!
jobs.description:
Hvem er jeg?

Jeg er en kvinne på 38 år som bor i Nittedal (Gjelleråsen, rett ved oslogrensa) sammen med mine to barn. Vi har gode kollektivforbindelser til både Oslo og Romerike.

Jeg lever med utmattelsessykdommen ME og bruker til tider rullestol utendørs/ved aktiviteter. Brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA) er min måte å organisere praktisk og personlig bistand på. Målet med ordningen er å gi meg avlastning og frigjøre krefter, slik at jeg kan være til stede for familien min og leve et mer selvstendig liv. Arbeidsoppgavene vil variere ut fra min dagsform.

Hvem søker jeg?

Jeg søker en ny fast assistent i en 9-timers stilling per uke, med gode muligheter for ekstra timer ved behov, sykdom og ferieavvikling.

Ønsker du en meningsfull jobb hvor du kan bidra til å gjøre en reell, positiv forskjell i hverdagen til en familie? Jeg ser etter deg som er presis, pliktoppfyllende, selvgående og fleksibel. Personlig egnethet og gode samarbeidsevner vektlegges høyt.

Kvinner oppfordres til å søke.

Hva skal du gjøre?

  • Matlaging og ernæring: Planlegge, tilberede og servere måltider, opprydning etter mat.

  • Barn og logistikk: Bistå med oppfølging og kjøring/henting til barnas fritidsaktiviteter og avtaler.

  • Skjerming og tilrettelegging: Bidra til ro og tilrettelegge for energiøkonomisering i hverdagen.

  • Husarbeid og ærender: Rengjøring, klesvask, handling og forefallende praktisk arbeid i hjemmet.

  • Bistand ut av huset: Følge til avtaler (som legetimer, turer og ærender), hvor rullestol kan bli benyttet utendørs.

Hva kreves av deg?

  • Førerkort klasse B er et krav. Det er en fordel om du disponerer egen bil og er en trygg sjåfør.

  • Gode norskkunnskaper (minimum nivå B1, både skriftlig og muntlig).

  • God fysisk form (evne til å håndtere/løfte rullestol inn og ut av bil og dytte rullestol i utendørs terreng).

  • Forståelse for skjermingsbehov: Du må ha evne til å være en god «usynlig hjelper» som respekterer ro og tilpasser deg skiftende dagsform.

  • Erfaring med barn: Du må være glad i barn og ha evne til å møte barn som krever god forutsigbarhet og trygghet.

  • Godkjent politiattest (vandel) må fremvises før oppstart.

Om stillingen

Stillingstype: Fast ansettelse

Stillingsstørrelse: 9 timer per uke (med gode muligheter for ekstravakter)

Arbeidstid: Etter nærmere avtale (dag/kveld/helg tilpasses etter behov)

Arbeidssted: Nittedal (Hagan)


Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Tarifflønn, ansiennitetsregulert

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Veiledning og opplæring

  • Assistentkurs i regi av Humana Omsorg og Assistanse

  • Egen app for håndbøker og rutiner

  • Rabatter hos bl.a. SATS

  • Attraktive rabatter med fordelsprogrammet Visma LogBuy

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.title: 2 Mekanikere/montører søges til spændende automotive virksomhed i Horsens N, Gedved
jobs.description:
RENTEQ Automotive søger efter praktiske og dygtige mekanikere/montører, der kan tage hånd om den mekaniske/eltekniske montage på vores fabrik i Gedved, og som har det rette mindset til at arbejde i en produktion, hvor processerne løbende optimeres.

Om RENTEQ Automotive

RENTEQ Automotive er en ung dansk virksomhed med en ambition om at reducere CO₂-udledningen ved at elektrificere varebiler og entreprenørmaskiner og opbygge batteritrailere. Vi har udvikling i Dragør og produktion på vores fabrik i Gedved, og vi tager hele rejsen på os – fra ingeniørarbejde og udvikling helt frem til serieproduktion.

Jobbet

Som mekaniker/montør hos os arbejder du med den praktiske montage på produktionslinjen – primært opbygning af vores Vanteq, på sigt også entreprenørmaskiner og vores batteritrailer.

Produktionen er stadig ung, så der er masser af plads til at forbedre den. Du arbejder tæt sammen med ingeniør- og produktionsteamet, bidrager til problemløsning tidligt og hjælper os med at bygge klogere fra gang til gang. Du er med til at sikre, at hver eneste komponent behandles korrekt og dokumenteres præcist, idet dit arbejde er fundamentet for hele konverteringsprojektet.

Dine typiske opgaver vil være:

●      Montage af Vanteq på produktionslinjen – efter fastlagte arbejdsinstruktioner

●      Montering af elektriske komponenter, kabelføring og drivline i chassis og karosseri

●      Tilpasning og fejlfinding på komponenter i tæt samarbejde med elektronik- og software-teamet

●      Kvalitetskontrol og dokumentation af alle monteringssteps og fund undervejs i produktionen

●      Løbende forbedring af proces og arbejdsgange – du kan bidrage til de guider og checklister, vi udvikler

●      Primært arbejde med Vanteq – og også entreprenørmaskiner kommer nok også ind i Gedved

●      Sammen holder vi altid produktionen organiseret, udstyr vedligeholdt og processer dokumenteret for at sikre den højest mulige kvalitet.

Er det dig?

Vi leder efter en person med solid praktisk erfaring og en tilgang, der kombinerer præcision med fleksibilitet. Vigtigst er, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også er dygtig til at samarbejde i et team, der hele tiden lærer og udvikler sig. Det vil være en fordel, hvis du kan nikke ja til nedenstående:

●      Erfaring med montering og demontering af motor, hydrauliksystem og brændstofkomponenter på landbrugsmaskiner, entreprenørmaskiner eller varebiler

●      Solidt kendskab til mekaniske systemer, væskesystemer og elektriske grundelementer

●      Ideelt set en stærk interesse for elektrificering

●      AC-kursus eller tilsvarende (ikke obligatorisk, men en stor fordel)

●      Evnen til at arbejde struktureret og dokumentere dit arbejde

●      Selvstændighed og ansvar, men også åbenhed over for feedback og samarbejde

●      Tålmodighed og en positiv tilgang til arbejde i et udviklingsmiljø, hvor vi hele tiden forfiner processen

●      Dansk på højt niveau; fungerende engelsk er en fordel, da vi er et internationalt team.

Vi tilbyder

●      Mulighed for at påvirke og udforme arbejdsprocesserne – dine idéer og erfaringer bliver hørt

jobs.title: Machine Operator - Vestfold (Norvège) M/W/X
jobs.description:
Do you want a practical and active job in a growing company?

CC Tekstilservice AS is looking for a machine operator / production worker with operational responsibility for our production facility in Sande.

We are looking for someone who wants an active and varied workday and enjoys combining practical work with responsibility for workflow, quality and completion.

You will become an important part of the team that ensures clothing and other textiles are processed correctly and delivered to our customers on time and to the right quality standard.

This is an operational role with responsibility. You will work actively in production yourself while, after training, taking responsibility for parts of the production flow and being expected to take ownership of your own area of responsibility.

The position is well suited to someone with a strong work capacity, flexibility and a willingness to take responsibility.

You do not necessarily need previous experience in production or textile care. What matters most is that you are willing to learn, work efficiently and contribute positively to the team.

As a machine operator / production worker, you will work hands-on and operationally in production. The role includes operating production equipment, processing textiles and taking responsibility for parts of the daily production flow. The main focus is the treatment of clothing and garments, while you will also handle other types of textiles. After training, you will be responsible for part of the production flow and follow established procedures for quality, efficiency and smooth operations. This means that you will not only carry out your own tasks, but also help ensure good workflow, correct prioritisation and that work within your area of responsibility is completed on time and to the required quality. When needed, you will also assist with ironing and pressing clothing and textiles, as well as packing and preparing finished products. The workday is active and physical, with varied tasks and a pace that is adapted to the production flow and the day's workload. During busy periods, it is important that you are flexible, solution-oriented and willing to help where the need is greatest so that production runs smoothly and deliveries are completed on time.

Who is the position suitable for?

We are looking for a positive and reliable employee who likes getting things done and is comfortable taking responsibility. You take responsibility for your own tasks, follow them through to completion and actively contribute to a smooth production flow. 

We are looking for someone who:

  • has a strong work capacity and enjoys an active workday
  • is flexible and contributes where needed
  • takes responsibility and ownership of their own tasks
  • works in a structured and efficient manner
  • is accurate and quality-conscious
  • is solution-oriented and takes initiative
  • works well with others
  • can handle a fast pace and varying workloads
  • wants to learn and develop
  • can communicate in a Scandinavian language or English and understand procedures and safety requirements

Experience from production, textile care or machine operation is an advantage, but not a requirement. The right attitude, work ethic, sense of responsibility and ability to learn are highly valued by us.

Key responsibilities

  • Take responsibility for parts of the daily production flow
  • Contribute to planning, prioritising and following up production
  • Operate production equipment, including dry-cleaning machines and washing machines
  • Work with the treatment of clothing, garments and other textiles
  • Monitor quality throughout the production process
  • Ensure that tasks within your area of responsibility are completed on time and to the required quality
  • Contribute to good workflow and efficient production
  • Follow procedures for machinery, operations, order and quality
  • Carry out basic maintenance of production equipment
  • Help the department achieve its production targets
  • When needed, assist with ironing, pressing, packing and preparing finished products

Training and development opportunities

You will receive thorough training in:

  • machinery and production equipment
  • washing and dry cleaning
  • textile care
  • stain treatment and spotting
  • finishing
  • quality assurance
  • production flow and internal procedures

Our goal is for you, after training, to take ownership of your own area of responsibility and actively contribute to production that is efficient, well structured and delivers the required quality. For the right person, there are also good opportunities for further professional development, including the possibility of working towards a Norwegian trade certificate (fagbrev) in textile cleaning.

Permanent, full-time position in a stable and growing company

- Thorough training and orderly working conditions

- A good and inclusive working environment with friendly colleagues

- Opportunities for professional and personal development for the right person

- Competitive terms by agreement

- Possibility of housing/accommodation by further agreement
