jobs.title: Vil du være med å skape trygghet på veiene?
jobs.description:
Ramudden søker nå flere trafikkmedarbeidere til vår avdeling i Drammen. 

Trives du i en aktiv hverdag med mye utfordringer og variasjon i arbeidet? Setter du sikkerhet og folka først? Vi ser etter trafikkmedarbeidere som kan hjelpe oss å vokse videre og møte etterspørselen fra våre kunder i tiden fremover.

Vi bistår våre kunder med alt innenfor trafikksikkerhet, og du vil få mulighet til å være tett på både små og store vei-, vedlikeholds- og byggeprosjekter i hele Buskerud.

 

Arbeidsoppgaver 

  • Dirigere trafikk og bidra til trygg ferdsel ved vei- og anleggsarbeid
  • Ledebilkjøring
  • Montering av midlertidig sikring
  • Transportoppdrag
  • Forvarslingsvogn
  • Skilting

Vi har også monteringsoppdrag tilknyttet bygg, anlegg, tunneldrift og ulike vakt- og beredskapsoppdrag. Vi er ofte involvert i større publikumsarrangementer i området, så her er det stor variasjon og ingen dag er lik! 

 

Hvem vi søker

Vi er en sammensatt gjeng med ulik bakgrunn, erfaring og utdanning. Har du erfaring fra bransjen, er det en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det viktigste for oss er at du tar sikkerhet på alvor og forholder deg til gjeldende regler og rutiner som bidrar til at alle kommer trygt hjem hver dag. En jobb hos oss innebærer et viktig ansvar for sikkerheten til både kolleger, trafikanter og andre som ferdes på og langs norske veier. 

Kvalifikasjoner: 

  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Førerkort klasse BE og C er en fordel, men ikke et krav
  • Bestå AVK 1 og 3 (ikke et krav før ansettelse, men du må bestå dette for å kunne jobbe ute på veien)
  • Av sikkerhetsårsaker og dokumentasjonskrav må du kunne kommunisere godt på norsk, muntlig og skriftlig
  • Benytte telefon og ulike digitale systemer i din arbeidshverdag

Personlige egenskaper: 

  • Har godt humør og bidrar positivt i møte med både kunder og kolleger
  • Jobber strukturert og nøyaktig, med høyt fokus på sikkerhet og dokumentasjon.
  • Er fleksibel når det gjelder arbeidstid og kan jobbe både dag, kveld og natt
  • Er praktisk og teknisk anlagt
  • Trives med en fysisk arbeidshverdag som innebærer å stå/gå/løfte utstyr

 

Vi kan tilby 

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn etter tariff
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø og gode kollegaer som har det morsomt sammen på jobb
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter internt i Ramudden, lokalt og nasjonalt
  • En fleksibel arbeidshverdag som passer godt for deg som trives med varierte arbeidstider
  • 30-60 % stilling

 

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Vi gleder oss til å få flere nye kolleger med på laget, og håper du er en av dem!

Ta gjerne kontakt om du skulle ha noen spørsmål.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og 1 milliard euro i omsetning. Selskapet har hovedkontor i Gävle i Sverige, og består av over 70 avdelinger i 13 land fordelt på 2 kontinenter. Konsernets misjon er å bringe folk hjem trygt hver dag (To get people home safely every day). Ramudden i Norge har vokst siden starten i 2009 og spesielt etter 2015. I dag består selskapet av 13 forskjellige avdelinger fra Steinkjer i nord til Lindesnes i sør. Vi er drøyt 500 medarbeidere og omsetningen nærmer seg 500 millioner kroner, med store ambisjoner om å vokse enda mer. Ramudden leverer sikkerhetstjenester i og rundt veinettet og på byggeplasser i Norge, blant annet rådgivning, utleie av sikkerhetsutstyr, opplæring av personell, og tjenesteleveranser som f.eks. montering av utstyr og trafikkdirigering.

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja, sosiaalihuollon resurssiyksikkö, Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue
jobs.description:
Haemme ammattitaitoisia ja motivoituneita lähihoitajia varahenkilöstöön toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen vammaispalveluun, mielenterveys- ja päihdepalvelut sekä vanhuspalveluun. Tarvitsemme tiimiimme joustavia ja sopeutuvia ammattilaisia, jotka pystyvät tukemaan yksiköitämme äkillisissä sijaistarpeissa.

Varahenkilönä työskenteleminen on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa. Se tarjoaa loistavan mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistaan ja laajentaa kokemusta eri työympäristöissä. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää joustavuutta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kykyä toimia sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä.

Odotamme, että sinulla on aikaisempaa työkokemusta alalta ja osaamista asiakastyöstä sekä kuntoutuksesta. Erityisesti arvostamme positiivista ja iloista asennetta sekä hyviä yhteistyötaitoja.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Esimiehen täyden tuen ja hyvät työtoverit
- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä monipuolisessa työssä
- Joustavat työajat ja työskentely-ympäristön, joka tukee hyvinvointiasi ja ammatillista kehittymistäsi.

Jos sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaidot, positiivinen asenne ja intoa työskennellä eri ihmisryhmien kanssa, voit olla etsimämme henkilö. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

Tervetuloa osaksi tiimiämme!

jobs.title: Seasonal Worker wanted with forklift certificate – for the pumpkin season 2026
jobs.description:
About Thorsbjerggaard

Thorsbjerggaard is a Danish farm specializing in the cultivation of edible pumpkins. Our products are supplied to many major Danish supermarkets and specialty stores. We also grow peas, squash, and watermelons.

All work is carried out on the farm, including cultivation, harvesting, washing, and packing.

A valid forklift certificate is an advantage and will be preferred.

The certificate must be valid for use in Europe.

Only applicants with a forklift certificate will be considered for the position.

Working Period

As soon as possible – end of March 2027

Working Hours

During warm periods, work usually starts at 5:00 a.m. and continues until around 12:00 noon. During busy periods, additional work in the afternoon may be required.

Working hours may vary depending on the weather and workload. Part-time work may occur. You will have at least one day off per week.

Language Requirements

You must be able to speak and understand English.

Wages

Monthly salary

Registered with the Danish tax authorities (SKAT)

Salary paid directly into your bank account, with a pay slip

Requirements

  • You must be at least 18 years old.

  • EU citizenship (a valid passport or national ID card is required).

  • Good physical condition, motivation, and a positive attitude.

  • Farm or harvesting experience is an advantage but not required.

  • A clean criminal record certificate from your home country.

We Expect You To

  • Be reliable and arrive on time.

  • Be flexible and willing to help wherever needed.

  • Work well as part of a team with people from different cultures.

  • Be able to communicate in English.

Accommodation

We have a campsite located on the farm, where you can rent a space in a caravan. Each caravan can accommodate up to four people.

Beds with mattresses are provided, but you must bring your own sleeping bag and bed linen.

The campsite offers access to toilets, showers, laundry facilities, shared cooking facilities (you prepare your own meals), and internet access.

The accommodation fee is all-inclusive.

The cost of accommodation in a caravan is DKK 70 per person per day. A refundable deposit of DKK 1,500 is required and will be returned if everything is left in the same condition as when you arrived.

Holiday Allowance

Holiday allowance will be transferred to FerieKonto and paid according to Danish holiday regulations.

Hygiene Rules

All hygiene regulations relating to the handling and harvesting of food products must be strictly followed. You will receive detailed instructions before starting work.

Failure to follow the hygiene rules may result in immediate dismissal without further warning.

What to Bring

  • Please remember to bring:

  • Sleeping bag

  • Warm clothing

  • Practical work clothes

  • Boots and waterproof clothing

  • Even in good weather, the plants can be very wet in the morning.

Important Documents

You must bring:

  • A valid national ID card (and passport, if possible)

  • A valid IBAN bank account in your own name

  • Documentation proving that you have health insurance in your home country

  • Tax Information 2026

  • You must bring documentation showing that you have a permanent address in your home country.

  • If you worked for us last year and have had other jobs since then, please bring documentation from your most recent employer.

  • If you are married, documentation of your marital status is required.

  • Please bring copies of all original documents, as well as English translations.

How to Apply

jobs.title: Varme- og ventilationstekniker søges
jobs.description:
Varme- og ventilationstekniker søges

Vi søger en erfaren og ansvarsbevidst varme- og ventilationstekniker til en fuldtidsstilling.

Arbejdsopgaver

Arbejdet omfatter installation, service, vedligeholdelse og reparation af varme-, ventilations- og VVS-installationer.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

* Installation, service og reparation af varme- og ventilationsanlæg

* Montering og udskiftning af rør, fittings, ventiler og pumper

* Arbejde med VVS-installationer og tekniske anlæg

* Fejlfinding, kontrol og vedligeholdelse af eksisterende installationer

* Udførelse af installations- og serviceopgaver hos virksomhedens kunder

* Sikring af, at arbejdet udføres korrekt og i overensstemmelse med gældende regler og sikkerhedskrav

Kvalifikationer

Vi forventer, at du har relevant uddannelse og/eller praktisk erhvervserfaring inden for varme, ventilation, VVS eller tilsvarende teknisk arbejde.

Du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret samt samarbejde med kolleger og kunder.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen.

Løn og øvrige ansættelsesvilkår aftales på baggrund af kvalifikationer og erfaring og vil være på et niveau, der svarer til danske standarder for stillingen.

Arbejdsstedet vil være på virksomhedens adresse samt på skiftende arbejdssteder hos virksomhedens kunder afhængigt af de konkrete arbejdsopgaver.

Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og CV til permanent@permanentingenior.dk .

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

jobs.description:
Er du en dansktalende studerende, som brænder for muligheden for at være med helt fremme, når en ny AI-virksomhed bygges op?

Hos Dirigento AI får du en unik mulighed for at komme med på et meget tidligt tidspunkt, hvor tempoet er højt, læringskurven stejl, og hvor dit arbejde vil have direkte betydning for, hvordan vi vinder vores første kunder.

Om rollen

Du kommer til at arbejde direkte sammen med ledelsen og være med til at skabe momentum i markedet. Dine ansvarsområder vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Research af potentielle kunder og målgrupper

  • Opsøgende arbejde via LinkedIn, e-mail og telefon

  • Support til salgs- og go-to-market-initiativer

Rollen er ideel for dig, der kan lide at tage ejerskab, trives i et hurtigt miljø og elsker at få tingene til at ske.

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er i gang med en bachelor- eller kandidatuddannelse

  • Kan arbejde 10-20 timer om ugen

  • Har en proaktiv tilgang og masser af energi

  • Er nysgerrig på AI, startups og forretningsudvikling

  • Er tryg ved at kontakte nye mennesker

  • Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt

  • Er ivrig efter at lære salg og kundeudvikling fra bunden

  • Muligheden for at være med i en ambitiøs AI-startup helt fra begyndelsen

  • En rolle med stort ansvar og gode læringsmuligheder

  • Gode muligheder for, at rollen kan vokse i takt med både dig og virksomheden

  • Indblik på nærmeste hold i, hvordan en startup skaffer og opbygger sin første kundebase

Hvis du er ambitiøs, proaktiv og har lyst til at være med til at bygge noget op fra bunden, kan det her være starten på noget stort. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Mitro Turunen på mt@dirigento.com.

Vykonávať administratívne úlohy spojené s pracovným miestom: - vyplnenie pracovného výkazu, - vedenie dokumentácie o činnostiach, - iné podľa potreby EduHubu. Vykonávať pracovné činnosti podľa potreby a pokynov zamestnávateľa.

Hľadáme predovšetkým ľudí, ktorí sú ochotní vydať sa na cestu rozvoja škôl vo svojom regióne.

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Správcovia objektov
jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

jobs.title: Správcovia systémov

Podpora používateľov pri práci s Microsoft 365 a štandardnými kancelárskymi aplikáciami. Správa používateľských účtov, hesiel a prístupových oprávnení podľa interných postupov. Evidencia a aktualizácia inventára IT hardvéru a softvéru. Spolupráca pri nákupe, príprave a vydávaní IT techniky novým zamestnancom. Základná správa tlačového prostredia vrátane riešenia bežných problémov s tlačiarňami a skenermi. Podpora výrobných pracovísk pri riešení základných IT problémov ovplyvňujúcich výrobnú prevádzku. Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

In a period of heightened regulatory scrutiny and continuing globalization of AML/CTF regulation, organizations are faced with greater challenges to achieving and maintaining their AML/CTF compliance.

jobs.description:
Head of Marketing and Communications (m/f/d)

Job Description

As Head of Marketing and Communications, you are accountable for shaping, amplifying, and protecting the firm's strategic priorities, growth agenda, and market positioning. Working closely with Executive Leadership, Business Development, and Sector Leads, you translate business strategy into compelling narratives, integrated go-to-market approaches, and high-impact marketing and communications activity.You lead the end-to-end marketing and communications agenda, spanning brand, reputation, digital, campaigns, events, internal communications, and employer branding. You explore and embed AI-enabled, insight-driven ways of working across all activities to deliver measurable commercial, reputational, and engagement impact.

AI is reshaping how clients discover expertise, consume content, engage with the firm, and make buying decisions, while also transforming the speed, skills, controls, and operating model required within Marketing and Communications. The role must therefore lead a deliberate shift in ways of working—redesigning processes rather than simply adding tools, strengthening data and content governance, building AI literacy and adoption across the team, and maintaining human judgement, creativity, brand integrity, and accountability.

This transformation must be closely connected to Business Development, sector priorities, and the firm's growth agenda, using AI and market insight to identify opportunities, sharpen propositions, personalise engagement, accelerate go-to-market activity, and improve pipeline conversion and commercial impact.

What you will be working on

Strategy, Planning & Leadership

• Translate business priorities into integrated marketing and communications plans.
• Partner with Business Development and Sector Leads to support growth, demand generation, and pipeline development.
• Drive governance, prioritization, and performance measurement across all marketing activities.
• Ensure consistent brand positioning, messaging, visual identity, and storytelling.

External Communications & Reputation

• Lead media relations, public relations, executive communications, and thought leadership.
• Support firm-wide initiatives and manage reputational risks.

Digital Marketing, Campaigns & Demand Generation

• Develop and execute digital, social media, and multi-channel marketing campaigns.
• Oversee SEO/SEM, paid media, marketing automation, and analytics.
• Use data and insights to optimize performance and commercial impact.

Events, Sponsorships & Partnerships

• Lead strategic events, sponsorships, memberships, and partnerships that enhance brand visibility and client engagement.

Internal Communications & Employer Brand

• Drive internal communications and employee engagement initiatives.
• Partner with HR to strengthen employer branding and talent attraction.
• Ensure alignment between employee experience and external reputation.

AI, Transformation & Operations

• Embed AI capabilities across marketing and communications to improve insight, creativity, efficiency, and effectiveness.
• Redesign processes and operating models to support AI-enabled ways of working.
• Ensure appropriate governance, quality control, compliance, and data protection.

Financial & People Leadership

• Own the marketing and communications budget and resource allocation.
• Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing team.
• Build capabilities in digital marketing, analytics, AI, and storytelling.
• Manage agency and vendor relationships.

What we look for

• Significant leadership experience (minimum 15 years) across Marketing and Communications, ideally within professional services, financial services, or another complex, regulated, knowledge-led environment.
• Proven ability to translate business strategy into impactful marketing and communication plans.
• Strong executive presence with the ability to influence and advise senior stakeholders.
• Extensive experience in brand management, communications, content strategy, and storytelling.
• Strong expertise in digital marketing, campaigns, social media, SEO/SEM, marketing automation, and analytics.
• Commercial and data-driven mindset, with the ability to demonstrate business impact.Experience leading transformation, change management, and AI adoption initiatives.
• Knowledge of GDPR and communications compliance requirements.Proven people leadership skills with experience building high-performing teams and fostering collaboration.
• Native English level. Additional languages relevant to Luxembourg's international environment are an asset.

Skills and Experience

Strategic Leadership

• Proven ability to translate business strategy into measurable marketing and communications plans
• Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders

Brand and Creative Direction

• Deep experience in brand positioning, creative briefing, content strategy, and storytelling, constantly pushing for creative ways to push the brand while adhering to brand guidelines where necessary.

Digital Marketing and Analytics

• Hands-on expertise in SEO/SEM, paid media, marketing automation, social platforms, and analytics
• Strong data-driven mindset with the ability to connect activity to commercial impact

Operational Excellence

• Budget ownership, vendor and agency management, contract negotiation, and scalable process design

Regulatory Awareness

• Familiarity with GDPR and professional services compliance requirements

Leadership and Collaboration

• Proven people leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and change management capability

Job Description & Summary

Meet your future team

Join our People Process Outsourcing (PPO) team within Human Capital, where specialists support clients with payroll, immigration and HR administration through a secure digital platform tailored to Luxembourg requirements. You will work closely with payroll experts, HR specialists and international colleagues to deliver compliant and efficient people processes for local and cross-border workforces.
What your role will look like

As a Payroll & HR Administration Associate, you will contribute to the accurate delivery of payroll and HR administration services for a portfolio of clients. Your role helps organisations stay compliant with Luxembourg and international requirements while ensuring employees receive a reliable and seamless payroll experience.

• Deliver end-to-end payroll calculations, including salary, bonuses, benefits, pension contributions, meal vouchers and other compensation components, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
• Prepare and coordinate monthly payroll reporting and declarations with tax and social security authorities.
• Manage payroll-related interactions with Luxembourg authorities, including the CCSS, CNS, ACD and ITM.
• Support the onboarding and payroll implementation of new clients, helping establish efficient and compliant processes from day one.
• Guide clients through their HR administration obligations and provide practical support on day-to-day people processes.
• Advise clients on payroll and HR compliance matters, including situations involving cross-border employment arrangements.
• Collaborate with colleagues across payroll, tax and HR disciplines to deliver consistent and high-quality client outcomes.
Your growth and opportunities
Develop your expertise in Luxembourg payroll legislation while gaining exposure to cross-border employment, tax and social security topics. Over time, you will take ownership of increasingly complex client situations and contribute to onboarding projects and process improvements. You will also strengthen your digital and advisory capabilities through close collaboration with specialists across the team.

The skills you bring

• Bachelor's degree with 1–2 years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree in Management, Human Resources, Payroll Administration, Tax Law or a related field.
• Experience or strong exposure to payroll administration and HR-related processes.
• Microsoft Excel: Proficient / Independent use for payroll calculations, data analysis and reporting.
• Microsoft Word: Proficient / Independent use for documentation and client communications.
• Fluency in English and French

Ways of working

• You analyse information logically, identify patterns in payroll and HR data, and use sound judgement to resolve issues accurately.
• You collaborate effectively with colleagues, clients and stakeholders to achieve shared outcomes and deliver a consistent service experience.
• You actively seek opportunities to learn, adapt to new regulations and technologies, and continuously improve the way work is delivered.
• You act with integrity, handle confidential information with care, and uphold high ethical standards in every situation.
Encouragement to apply

The skills listed reflect what matters most to succeed in this role. If your experience aligns with them, even if your path looks different, we encourage you to apply and start the conversation with us.

Take your next step

Contribute to payroll and HR solutions that help organisations operate with confidence and compliance. Build your expertise alongside specialists who value quality, collaboration and continuous learning while supporting clients across Luxembourg and beyond. Grow here. Go further.

Intitulé du poste
Senior Relationship Manager - Real Estate

Activités / Missions

Présente au Luxembourg depuis plus de 100 ans, la Banque de Luxembourg est un acteur financier incontournable de la place au service de clients privés, des entreprises luxembourgeoises et de clients professionnels issus des métiers de la gestion d'actifs. Certifiée B Corp depuis 2023, notre Banque s'engage à renforcer l'impact social, sociétal et environnemental de ses activités.

Envie d'accompagner et de financer les grands projets qui transforment le Luxembourg ?

Le pôle Immobilier de notre département Entreprises et Entrepreneurs accompagne les acteurs incontournables du secteur immobilier à Luxembourg en leur offrant des solutions de financement structurées et une expertise conseil de premier plan. Notre force ? Un ancrage local fort et une capacité à intervenir sur tous les métiers de l'immobilier.
Nous intervenons comme un véritable partenaire stratégique dans l'ensemble des activités de nos clients :
La promotion immobilière
L'investissement immobilier
La construction

En tant que Senior Relationship Manager - Real Estate, vous gérez de manière autonome un portefeuille de clients professionnels de l'immobilier et les accompagnez dans leurs projets et dans leurs besoins bancaires quotidiens.

• Vous étudiez les demandes de financement d'acteurs professionnels du secteur immobilier : vous analysez la faisabilité économique et financière de projets immobiliers et étudiez les rapports financiers ;
• Vous rédigez et structurez les demandes de crédits, proposez des solutions de financement en ligne avec l'appétit risque de la banque et défendez les dossiers devant les comités compétents ;
• Vous collaborez avec le département Crédit et Juridique afin de réaliser la documentation juridique et contractuelle relative au financement ;
• Vous assurez le suivi des opérations financées, veillez à une utilisation correcte des fonds et anticipez les risques éventuels ;
• Vous contribuez à la réalisation de crédits syndiqués (club deals) avec d'autres banques ;
• Vous développez et entretenez un réseau solide auprès des principaux acteurs de l'écosystème et représentez la banque à l'occasion d'évènements pour participer à son rayonnement ;
• Vous développez de nouvelles relations clients et identifiez des nouvelles opportunités pour atteindre vos objectifs commerciaux ;
• Vous assurez la revue périodique des engagements et vous veillez au respect des exigences de conformité des comptes (KYC, KYT, AML etc.)

Profil

De formation Bac+5 en sciences économiques, commerciales ou financières, vous avez au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans un établissement bancaire au Luxembourg avec une expérience de minimum 5 ans dans le domaine des financements immobiliers ;
• Vous disposez d'excellentes connaissances en matière de crédits, d'analyse bilantaire et financière, et vous maîtrisez les concepts de financement de projets ;
• Vous disposez d'une expérience avérée dans les financements syndiqués ou financements en club deal et êtes familiers avec les contrats LMA ;
• Vous justifiez de connaissances approfondies liées au marché et aux technicités de l'immobilier au Luxembourg et connaissez les principaux acteurs locaux ;
• Vous disposez d'une proactivité et d'une autonomie forte et êtes orientés résultat ;
• Votre aisance relationnelle, votre sens de la négociation couplée à votre orientation client et à votre engagement professionnel font de vous un interlocuteur apprécié, capable d'établir une relation privilégiée avec les clients ;
• Rigoureux·euse, flexible et organisé·e, vous êtes également doté·e d'excellentes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse et de bonnes aptitudes rédactionnelles ;
• Vous parlez couramment le français et l'anglais, la maîtrise du luxembourgeois et/ou de l'allemand constitue un avantage.

Convaincus que notre diversité fait notre force, nous sommes signataires de la Charte de la Diversité, Lëtzebuerg. Attentifs à l'égalité des chances, nous nous engageons à travers des actions concrètes, notamment en faveur des jeunes talents, des femmes, des collaborateurs seniors…

Vous souhaitez …

• rejoindre des équipes composées de femmes et d'hommes d'horizons multiples, aux parcours et compétences complémentaires ,
• vous développer dans un cadre de travail respectant l'équilibre vie privée-vie professionnelle ;
• évoluer dans un environnement propice à l'épanouissement de tous les talents…

Adressez-nous votre CV accompagné d'une lettre de motivation via notre Espace Candidats.

Pour information, un extrait du casier judiciaire de moins de 2 mois vous sera demandé avant la conclusion de tout contrat de travail.

jobs.title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

jobs.title: Senior QA Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.
Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.
Annual sports grant.
A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.
Home internet.
A conditional monthly transportation grant.
Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.
On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.
Relocation Package.

Please submit your application in English.

Please apply by filling in an online application here: https://careers.fenriscreations.com/en/postings/d315eb37-715d-4657-b29d-484420749257
Application deadline 8th of october 2026

Chez IPSI, c'est C.A.A.R.Ré

CONFIANCE / AUTHENTICITE / AVENTURE HUMAINE / RECONNAISSANCE / REUSSITE

Nos valeurs guident notre quotidien et nous vous invitons à embarquer dans cette aventure palpitante avec nous !

Depuis plusieurs années, notre FIRST Académie a ouvert ses portes à divers talents avec pour objectifs de les former et de les intégrer dans nos équipes !  
De 2018 à aujourd'hui, pour 125 apprenants intégrés, c'est 86% de taux de satisfaction, 86% de réussite au TP et 92% de taux d'insertion dans l'emploi.

Les objectifs de la formation :

Nos apprenants passeront une formation de 3 mois au sein de nos locaux à Ivry sur seine pour apprendre à :

- Réaliser la maintenance préventive et corrective des systèmes de sécurité incendie
- Assurer la traçabilité des opérations effectuées et le conseil du client à l'issue d'une intervention

La formation allie cours théoriques et stage pratique sur site. Lors de son cursus, l'apprenant est accompagné d'un tuteur.

A l'issue de la formation, nous vous embaucherons en tant que technicien de maintenance SSI en CDI avec une période d'essai de 3 mois. Durant cette période, vous continuerez à être accompagné(e) afin de faciliter votre montée en compétences et votre intégration.

Disposer de connaissances et savoirs faire en électricité / électrotechnique, à minima un Bac pro MELEC ou acquis par l'expérience
Une bonne aisance avec les outils informatiques
Une bonne communication orale et écrite
Une bonne aisance relationnelle et le sens des responsabilités
Etre inscrit.e à France Travail

Notre process de recrutement pour vous intégrer dans cette formation :

Un échange téléphonique avec notre Chargé.e de recrutement
Des tests de prérequis (électricité et logique) et un entretien de motivation en face à face
La validation de votre candidature

Compter environ deux mois de délai entre votre entretien et votre intégration dans la formation.


La formation est entièrement gratuite. Pendant les 3 premiers mois, vous serez rémunéré(e) par France Travail via une indemnité de formation.

La formation se déroulera en Île-de-France. Pour les candidats résidant hors de la région, un hébergement sera mis à disposition durant toute la durée de la formation au sein du centre de formation. Deux allers-retours seront également pris en charge afin de vous permettre de rentrer chez vous le temps d'un week-end.

Si vous vous sentez prêt.e à endosser ce rôle , n'hésitez pas à postuler !

Ensemble, remplissons notre devoir avec détermination et passion !

Ipsi encourage les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap. Des accommodations seront fournies sur demande pour faciliter le processus de candidature.

Ipsi est résolument engagée dans une politique RSE, intégrant des pratiques durables pour un impact positif sur la société et l'environnement.

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


We're seeking an experienced Commercial Counsel to join our growing legal team and serve as a strategic partner to our rapidly expanding enterprise sales organization. In this high-impact role, you'll drive complex commercial negotiations that fuel our growth, working closely with our sales teams to close sophisticated technology agreements with enterprise customers across diverse industries. You'll play a critical role in scaling our commercial legal processes while navigating the evolving landscape of AI-powered development tools and ensuring our customers can confidently deploy Replit's platform in their organizations.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Drive Enterprise Deals: Serve as the lead legal advisor for complex, high-value enterprise sales transactions, working directly with our Account Executives and customer legal teams to negotiate and close sophisticated software agreements

 - Navigate AI & Technology Compliance: Help enterprise customers understand and navigate the legal and regulatory implications of adopting AI-powered development tools, addressing data privacy, security, and compliance requirements across various industries

 - Build Scalable Frameworks: Design and implement contract playbooks, template agreements, and streamlined processes that enable our sales team to move quickly while maintaining legal rigor as we scale

 - Risk Management: Identify, analyze, and proactively manage complex commercial and legal risks while maintaining deal velocity in our fast-paced, high-growth environment

 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Security, and Privacy teams to ensure our commercial offerings align with product capabilities and regulatory requirements

 - Strategic Advisory: Provide strategic guidance to leadership on commercial legal matters, emerging AI regulations, and market trends affecting developer tools and enterprise software adoption

 - Customer Relationship Building: Foster strong relationships with enterprise customer legal teams, becoming a trusted advisor who helps facilitate smooth adoption of Replit's platform




YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE

 - Legal Foundation: JD from an accredited law school and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar

 - Commercial Experience: 5-7 years of relevant legal experience supporting enterprise software sales and complex commercial transactions, preferably at high-growth technology companies

 - Technology Focus: Strong background in SaaS agreements, software licensing, and technology transactions, with bonus points for experience with AI/ML tools, developer platforms, or cloud infrastructure

 - Deal Velocity: Proven track record of successfully closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals in fast-paced environments while balancing legal risk with business objectives

 - Business Acumen: Exceptional business judgment and ability to provide practical, solutions-oriented legal advice that enables (rather than blocks) commercial success

 - Communication Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with experience presenting to and influencing C-level executives and enterprise customer stakeholders

 - Startup DNA: Thrives in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments where you'll need to build processes from the ground up and adapt quickly to changing priorities

 - Collaboration: Collaborative mindset with a track record of building strong cross-functional relationships and supporting high-velocity sales processes




BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

 - In-House Experience: Previous in-house counsel experience at technology companies, particularly those serving enterprise customers or developer audiences

 - AI/Developer Tools: Experience with AI, machine learning, or developer platform companies, including understanding of the unique legal considerations around code generation and AI-assisted development

 - Industry Knowledge: Experience working with enterprise customers in regulated industries or understanding of compliance requirements across different sectors

 - Scale Experience: Experience supporting sales teams through hypergrowth phases, including building legal processes that scale with rapid revenue expansion

Rattaché.e au gérant et au responsable multisites, vous supervisez 2 centres de vacances situés à Crest-Voland et au Cernix.

- Suivi des stocks

- Coordination des interventions techniques

jobs.title: Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique (H/F)
jobs.description:
Barcelone - Espagne
Rejoindre le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR
Dans le cadre de son développement, AXOR Ingénierie souhaite faire de Barcelone son futur pôle d'ingénierie, de coordination et de développement pour l'ensemble du groupe.
Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique capable de suivre les projets de manière autonome, de coordonner les différents intervenants et de contribuer au développement commercial du groupe.
Votre mission
En lien direct avec la Direction, les équipes techniques et les partenaires du groupe, vous prenez en charge le suivi des affaires depuis l'analyse du besoin client jusqu'à la coordination de la réalisation.
Votre rôle consiste à faire le lien entre les clients, les bureaux d'études, les équipes commerciales, les partenaires techniques et les unités de production afin de garantir le bon déroulement des projets.
Ce poste est basé à Barcelone, avec une activité tournée principalement vers le développement et le suivi des affaires en France et sur les autres marchés du groupe.
Vos principales responsabilités
Suivi des affaires et coordination technique
- Analyser les demandes clients, les dossiers techniques, plans et cahiers des charges ;
- Participer à l'étude de faisabilité technique et commerciale des projets ;
- Préparer, suivre et relancer les offres commerciales ;
- Coordonner les échanges entre clients, bureaux d'études, partenaires techniques et équipes internes ;
- Suivre l'avancement des projets, les délais, les priorités et les points de blocage ;
- Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la Direction ;
- Veiller à la bonne transmission des informations nécessaires à la production et à la réalisation des projets.
Développement commercial et relation partenaires
- Développer et entretenir un portefeuille de clients et partenaires ;
- Représenter AXOR auprès des acteurs du secteur : entreprises, bureaux d'études, architectes, maîtres d'œuvre, partenaires industriels ;
- Identifier de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires sur les marchés ciblés ;
- Participer à la structuration des méthodes commerciales et du suivi client ;
- Contribuer au développement des activités liées aux structures métalliques, à l'enveloppe du bâtiment et aux solutions constructives.
Profil recherché
- Expérience confirmée en chargé d'affaires, conduite de projets, développement commercial BTP, construction métallique, ingénierie ou environnement similaire ;
- Bonne compréhension des dossiers techniques, plans, métrés, chiffrages et contraintes chantier ;
- Capacité à piloter plusieurs affaires en parallèle avec rigueur et autonomie ;
- Aisance dans la relation client, la négociation et la coordination d'interlocuteurs variés ;
- Esprit entrepreneurial, sens de l'organisation et capacité à structurer son activité ;
- Profil terrain, réactif, fiable et orienté solutions ;
- Une expérience dans la construction métallique, le bâtiment industriel, l'enveloppe du bâtiment ou les structures métalliques serait fortement appréciée.
Langues
- Français courant indispensable ;
- Espagnol professionnel indispensable ;
- Anglais apprécié ;
- Turc apprécié.
Ce poste s'adresse à vous si..
En plus d'une solide compréhension technique et commerciale, nous recherchons une personne capable de prendre en main des affaires de manière autonome, de sécuriser le suivi des projets et de contribuer concrètement au développement du groupe.
Cadre de la collaboration
- CDI ou collaboration selon profil ;
- Poste basé à Barcelone ;
- Déplacements ponctuels à prévoir en France et auprès des clients / partenaires ;
- Rémunération selon profil et expérience.

jobs.description:
Er du klar til at forlade Danmark og det regnfulde vejr til fordel for den livlige, spændende og smukke by Barcelona? Og kunne du tænke dig at tilføje værdifuld arbejdserfaring med Google Ads til dit CV? Så er dette måske noget for dig!

Barcelona er hjemsted for mange store kunstnere og malere, så der er altid masser af kunst at udforske. Byens mest berømte kulturelle mesterværk er Gaudís værk, den imponerende katedral "Sagrada Familia," som repræsenterer en unik stil inden for moderne arkitektur.

Hvis du ikke er så vild med kunst og kultur, kan du tilbringe dagen på en af Barcelonas sandstrande, som kun ligger en kort gåtur fra byens centrum. Her kan du nyde noget af det bedste middelhavsinspirerede seafood. Byen har et ry for at være den mest kosmopolitiske, moderne og fremsynede by i Spanien. Selvom det er en meget moderne by, finder du stadig de gamle kvarterer som det gotiske kvarter, hvor byens ældste bygning ligger, samt utallige barer og butikker.

  • Konkurrencedygtig lønpakke og bonussystem

  • Udviklingsmuligheder inden for virksomheden

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Gratis fitnessmedlemskab

  • Præstationsbonusser

Om jobbet:

Som junior kampagne- og marketingspecialist vil du være ansvarlig for at forbedre og udvikle kampagner. Derfor vil du skulle rådgive og have gode forhandlingsevner – det er ikke aggressivt salg, men det er vigtigt, at du besidder nogle salgsmæssige kvaliteter. Dit daglige arbejde vil inkludere opgaver som:

  • Fungere som en betroet konsulent og onboarde kunder

  • Udvikle PPC-kampagner

  • Forstå kundernes behov og mål

  • Ansvar for at øge forbrug, mersalg og bæredygtighed

  • Håndtere en stor mængde potentielle kunder dagligt via telefonopkald

Dine kvalifikationer

Du taler dansk på modersmålsniveau og er flydende i engelsk (B2).

Erfaring: Minimum 1-2 års erfaring inden for salg og/eller online annoncering. Erfaring med outbound-opkald og salg (ikke påkrævet). BA/BS i Marketing, Digital Marketing eller Kommunikation er et plus.

Du har en god forståelse og et solidt niveau af computerfærdigheder.

Fremragende problemløsningsevner med evnen til at finde og identificere de rette oplysninger. Du har erfaring med og en passion for online display-annoncering.

Stærke kommunikations- og forhandlingsevner. Du er serviceorienteret, professionel og grundig.

  • Clear and effective communication in English — advanced ability to discuss business tasks, justify decisions, and communicate issues. Good self-presentation is also essential for upcoming client calls.

jobs.title: Service Desk Technician
jobs.description:
**Service Desk Technician**

JOB PURPOSE

Serve as the first point of contact for Curium employees and partners worldwide, providing timely, high-quality technical assistance through the Global Service Desk. Log, diagnose, resolve and/or escalate incidents and service requests in line with agreed SLAs, while contributing to knowledge and continuous service improvement.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE

- Provide first-line support via Freshservice, phone, chat and email; ensure accurate ticket creation and lifecycle updates.

- Troubleshoot and resolve incidents related to end-user devices, operating systems, Microsoft 365, collaboration tools and approved business applications.

- Fulfil service requests (software installation/configuration, access requests, equipment requests) following standard procedures and security policies.

- Support user onboarding/offboarding: account setup coordination, workstation readiness, and user guidance on core tools and security best practices.

- Use remote support tools to assist users; collaborate with local IT/field services when hands-on intervention is required.

- Escalate complex issues to the appropriate resolver groups (workplace, network, server, security, applications) with clear diagnostics and evidence.

- Create and maintain knowledge base articles, procedures and troubleshooting guides; contribute to reducing repeat incidents.

- Maintain accurate asset and user device records in Freshservice and ensure data quality for reporting and compliance.

- Communicate clearly and professionally with users, providing status updates and setting expectations throughout the resolution process.

- Participate in shift coverage and (where applicable) on-call/major incident support according to the Global Service Desk operating model.

- Backfill the field service desk technician on request.


WHAT YOU NEED FOR THIS POSITION

**Must have Experience/Skills:**

- Bachelor's degree in IT (or equivalent professional experience).

- 2+ years in a Service Desk / IT support role in an international environment.

- Demonstrated experience working with ITSM processes (Incident, Request, Knowledge) and SLAs.

- Strong troubleshooting skills on Windows and common end-user hardware/peripherals.

- Good knowledge of Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

- Familiarity with identity and access concepts (Active Directory / Entra ID), MFA and basic security hygiene.

- Experience with remote support tools and endpoint management basics (Intune / Autopilot / SCCM) is advantageous.

- Basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, WiFi, VPN, connectivity troubleshooting).

- Excellent customer service mindset; ability to prioritize and work under time pressure.

- Fluent in Finnish and English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus.


**Nice to have Experience/Skills:**

- Hands-on experience with Freshservice (or equivalent ITSM tool) including knowledge article creation.

- ITIL Foundation certification or practical ITIL experience.

- Experience supporting Teams telephony / conferencing room equipment.

- Exposure to regulated environments (GxP) and validated processes.

jobs.title: Experiment Support and Instrument Technician
jobs.description:
The company
The ILL is an international research facility at the forefront of neutron science and technology. Its High-Flux Nuclear Reactor delivers the world's most intense neutron beams to a suite of over 40 scientific instruments. Every year, some 1800 international researchers visit the ILL to carry out cutting-edge experiments across a range of scientific disciplines, driving innovation in the fields of health, energy, the environment and quantum materials. The ILL is also involved in the production of radioisotopes for medical applications. The ILL employs over 500 staff from 25 different countries, in a diversity of careers and a multicultural and inclusive environment.

The Science Division at ILL brings together close to 200 scientists, engineers, and technicians who work collaboratively to provide users with advanced experimental capabilities and expert scientific support. The DS is responsible by operating world-class neutron scattering instruments, supporting an international user community, conducting cutting-edge research, and developing new experimental techniques. In addition, the division drives the development of next-generation instrumentation and computational tools, fosters international collaborations, and contributes to advanced training.

About the position
As an experiment support and instrument technician, you will be responsible for the operation and development of experimental equipment and for providing support for experiments conducted at the ILL.
You will work closely with the scientists in charge of the instruments you will be assigned to. You will also collaborate with the other technicians in the Spectroscopy group. You will act as technical contact for the instrument WASP within this group. Depending on the needs of the different groups, you may be asked to work in parallel on other instruments within the Spectroscopy group.

Your tasks
Your main duties will involve the following:
-    Performing maintenance work and repairs on instruments and their ancillary equipment
-    Assisting in-house and visiting scientists with the preparation of their experiments
-    Designing new equipment in collaboration with ILL scientists and technical support groups
-    Improving the instruments and the way in which experiments are conducted by devising innovative technical solutions
-    Performing precision machining of simple mechanical parts (lathing, milling, drilling) at short notice
-    Installing, maintaining and operating sample environment equipment (cryostats, furnaces, etc.)
-    Organising the purchase of new equipment and spare parts

Desired profile
-    You have a Level 4/5 qualification (e.g. NVQ, BTEC HNC/HND or equivalent) in mechanical, maintenance or electronic engineering.
-    You have experience in the assembly and alignment of precision mechanical assemblies.
-    You have knowledge of CAD software.
-    Experience in scientific instrumentation, in particular in the field of cryogenics, would be an advantage.
-    You must have a sound knowledge of English and be willing to learn French (a language course will be paid for by the ILL).

Benefits
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.
