jobs.title: Directeur amélioration continue (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0

• Zone Industrielle P.E.D, BP 38, Rodange, Luxembourg, Luxembourg Employees work in a hybrid mode
• Full-time
• Compensation: EUR 116,340 - EUR 186,144 - yearly

Job Description

Are you ready to architect the future of Advanced Manufacturing?
At the Materials Group (MG), we are not just optimizing operations, we are redefining them. We are seeking a visionary and dynamic Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0  to lead our central Enterprise Lean System (ELS) function.
This is a high-impact, regional executive role designed for an operational architect who can bridge the gap between world-class, foundational Lean Six Sigma methodologies and cutting-edge Industry 4.0 technologies (AI, Predictive Analytics, and Cognitive Automation). Based in our Rodange facility, you will hold the keys to regional standardization, capability building, and digital supply chain transformation across Europe.

The Challenge & The Vision

As the Director of Central ELS, you will play two pivotal roles: the Guardian of Standards and the Pioneer of Innovation.
You will lead a high-performing central team to drive continuous improvement, establishing a high-margin production environment. Concurrently, you will orchestrate the transition from manual Lean frameworks to an AI-driven "Lighthouse Factory" footprint, leveraging predictive models, virtual environments, and connected systems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Guardian of Operational & Supply Chain Standards

• Act as the regional "Center as Guardian," serving as the sole architect of operational standards in the Regional Playbook.
• Govern all core manufacturing work standards (5S, Standard Work Audits, Daily Tier Meetings, Kaizen, SMED, TPM, and OEE Tracking/Loss Analysis).
• Establish robust supply chain standards, covering Production Planning Logic, Inventory Buffer Protocols, Freight Spend Governance, and S&OP Integration.
• Govern and standardize Data Science & AI models across the region.

2. Capability Builder & Training Academy Leader

• Standardize regional workforce mindsets and skillsets through a centralized regional training engine.
• Maintain the end-to-end certification pathway for Yellow, Green, and Black Belt mastery, alongside modern Digital Literacy pathways.
• Design functionally deep training curricula and scale execution through "Train-the-Trainer" initiatives with local site leaders.

3. Orchestrator of Strategy Deployment

• Lead the Yearly Strategic Deployment process ensuring 100% functional alignment between Sales, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and IT.
• Utilize the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and key performance metrics to establish regional breakthrough targets.
• Facilitate the collaborative "Catchball" process to negotiate and lock departmental action plans.
• Manage the monthly governance framework for PDCA reviews at executive and functional levels.

4. Pioneer of ELS 4.0 & Digital Twin Innovation

• Drive the shift to automated, AI-driven operations, implementing predictive models that empower local sites to preempt issues.
• Lead shopfloor IoT integration, ensuring machines feed real-time performance data directly into core IT systems.
• Deploy a Regional Control Tower live-dashboard to visualize the entire end-to-end supply chain.
• Deploy advanced solutions for AI-Driven Predictive Quality, Maintenance, Cognitive Automation, and dynamic 3D Digital Twin simulations.

5. Champion of the Hub & Spoke Model

• Serve as the central regional filter and amplifier for operational innovation.
• Capture best-in-class local site innovations directly from the Gemba, codifying validated successes into the "Gold Standard" regional playbook for network-wide deployment.

6. High-Performing Team Leader

• Cultivate an inspiring team culture rooted in high performance, psychological safety, and radical accountability.
• Mentor and coach a dedicated central team, providing clear career development pathways and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

Qualifications

Who You Are

• The Expert: You possess extensive experience leading Lean, Six Sigma, and Continuous Improvement functions on a regional or global scale.
• The Digital Native: You have a proven track record of implementing Industry 4.0 solutions (IoT, Predictive Maintenance, AI, or Digital Twins) within a manufacturing environment.
• The Architect: You excel at designing, documenting, and scaling operational systems and standards from scratch.
• The Communicator: You are an expert at navigating Hoshin Kanri / Strategic Deployment, bringing diverse stakeholders (from the shopfloor to the C-suite) along on the transformation journey.
• The People Developer: You love building capability, leading academies, and mentoring future operational leaders.

• Location: We welcome candidates residing near any of our major manufacturing hubs in Luxembourg, France, the UK, Germany, or Belgium.

Additional Information

Why join Avery Dennison:  We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. As a science and innovation company, we believe that diverse teams are stronger teams. We are committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and courage, where you can grow your career with a company that has innovation in its DNA. Founded on creating real-world impact to enable a better future, we strive to provide an open, collaborative culture where diversity of thought is encouraged and respected. Hear from our employees about what it's like working at Avery Dennison. Learn more at www.averydennison.com.At Avery Dennison, we work with the biggest brands in the FMCG, apparel, automotive, and pharma industries. Our Rodange Site Avery Dennison Luxembourg Sàrl location, founded in 1989, is a collaborative and dynamic environment that supports our Label and Packaging Materials Group division and employs approximately 540 talented individuals. Key functions at this site include Operations, Customer Service, central teams and various support functions, offering diverse career paths and opportunities for growth.

Equal Opportunity Employer:  Avery Dennison is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected status. If you are unable to use our online application process due to a disability, please contact us to request an accommodation at Requestaccomodation@eu.averydennison.com. In the EMEA region, we foster an inclusive culture through active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) like Elevate, Unite, and our Mental Health group. Please visit our DE&I page to learn more about our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach.

Pay Transparency Statement:  The salary range for this position is 116340 - 186144 EUR / year.

The hiring base salary range above represents what Avery Dennison reasonably expects to pay for this position as of the date of this posting. Actual salaries will vary within the range, and in some circumstances may be above or below the range, based on various factors including but not limited to a candidate's relevant skills, experience, education and training, and location, as well as the job scope and complexity, responsibilities, and regular and/or necessary travel required for the position, which may change depending on the candidate pool. Avery Dennison reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

FundRock LIS S.A. is a successful third-party UCITS management company and AIFM headquartered in Luxembourg and with an office in Dublin, delivering fund solutions to renowned investment managers and fund initiators.

Founded in 2011, we focus on private equity, real estate, infrastructure and debt asset classes. Today we are the leading third-party AIFM in the private funds space.

Role: AIFM Risk & Valuation Manager
Role Location: Luxembourg (Airport Center)
Employment Type: Permanent

Role summary:

Join our team as an AIFM Risk & Valuation Manager, where you'll play a key role in managing risk and valuations for alternative investment funds like private equity, real estate, and infrastructure. You'll work with advanced risk models, prepare reports for senior stakeholders, and support clients in setting up funds. This is a great opportunity to apply your analytical skills, grow your expertise, and make an impact in a dynamic, international environment.

Key responsibilities:

• Day-to-day risk management for alternative investment fund products (AIFs).
• Periodic review of valuations of alternative assets (private equity, real estate, infrastructure, debt instruments, etc.).

Skills / experience:

Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

As a vital team member and in return for your expertise, inclusive approach and commitment, we'll provide a favourable salary and the chance to join a passionate and welcoming team. Benefits As a truly global business, we tailor benefits to each location to safeguard our people and respect local cultures and ways of working. jobs.title: Consultant(e) – Manager Risk & Finance (h/f)
jobs.description:
Consultant(e) – Manager Risk & Finance (H/F)

Qui sommes-nous ?

Finegan Luxembourg fait partie du groupe Finegan, un cabinet de conseil français indépendant fondé en 2009. Notre mission est d'accompagner nos clients dans leurs transformations en favorisant innovation, proximité et engagement à long terme.
Nous valorisons le travail collectif et soutenons nos consultants dans leur développement professionnel tout en respectant nos engagements sociétaux.

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) Manager Risk & Finance disposant d'une solide expertise en gestion des risques et en finance, ainsi que d'une forte appétence pour le développement commercial et le management d'équipes.

Vos missions principales :

En tant que Manager, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de nos activités et l'accompagnement de nos clients du secteur financier.
À ce titre, vous serez amené(e) à :

• Développer et consolider un portefeuille de clients au sein des secteurs bancaires, assurance et fonds d'investissement.
• Identifier de nouvelles opportunités commerciales et contribuer activement à la croissance du cabinet.
• Piloter des missions de conseil en gestion des risques financiers, prudentiels et opérationnels.
• Accompagner les clients dans leurs problématiques de finance, de réglementation et de transformation.
• Encadrer, animer et faire monter en compétences des équipes de consultants et d'analystes.
• Assurer le suivi des missions, la qualité des livrables et la satisfaction des clients.
• Participer aux réponses aux appels d'offres et à la construction des offres de services.
• Contribuer à la réflexion stratégique et au développement des activités de Finegan Luxembourg.
• Assurer une veille réglementaire et sectorielle afin d'accompagner les clients dans l'évolution de leurs dispositifs de gestion des risques et de conformité.

Profil recherché :

• Diplôme de niveau Master en Finance, Statistiques, Mathématiques appliquées, Économie ou domaine équivalent.
• Expérience confirmée en gestion des risques et finance acquise au sein d'un cabinet de conseil, d'une banque, d'une compagnie d'assurance ou d'un gestionnaire d'actifs.
• Expérience significative dans la conduite de projets et l'accompagnement de transformations réglementaires.
• Solide expérience en management d'équipe et en encadrement de consultants.
• Forte sensibilité commerciale et goût pour le développement de relations clients durables.
• Excellente compréhension des enjeux actuels du secteur financier luxembourgeois et européen.

Compétences techniques

Gestion des risques

• Modélisation et validation des paramètres réglementaires (PD, LGD, EAD).
• Maîtrise des dispositifs de gestion des risques de crédit, de marché et opérationne
• Connaissance approfondie des méthodologies quantitatives appliquées au risque.
• Maîtrise des processus ICAAP, stress testing et dispositifs prudentiels.

Réglementation bancaire et prudentielle

• Bâle III / Bâle IV.
• CRD / CRR.
• Dispositifs de conformité et de gouvernance des risques.
• Réglementations applicables aux établissements bancaires, compagnies d'assurance et fonds d'investissement.

Finance

• Finance d'entreprise.
• Analyse financière.
• Valorisation et évaluation d'actifs.
• Normes IFRS appliquées aux instruments financiers.

Data & Outils Quantitatifs

• SAS.
• R.
• Python.
• MATLAB.

Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. jobs.title: UČITELJ/UČITELJICA TJELESNE I ZDRAVSTVENE KULTURE NA TALIJANSKOM JEZIKU
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10,105/10-ispr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12. 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja radnika u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ te čl. 7. Pravilnika o radu OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“, ravnateljica Osnovne škole-Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“ Rijeka, Mirka Čurbega 18, objavljuje N A T J E Č A J za popunjenje radnog mjesta 1 učitelj/učiteljica tjelesne i zdravstvene kulture na talijanskom jeziku na neodređeno i nepuno radno vrijeme (20 sati tjedno) uz uvjet probnog rada prema odredbama Temeljnog kolektivnog ugovora za službenike i namještenike u javnim službama TRAŽENI UVJETI:
  1. Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12., 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17 i 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) i sukladno Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN br. 6/19, 75/20):
- završen sveučilišni diplomski studij - potpuno vladanje talijanskim jezikom i pismom 2. Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju na jeziku i pismu nacionalnih manjina (NN 51/00.,56/00-ispr.). Na oglašena radna mjesta mogu se javiti osobe oba spola, sukladno čl. 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/16, 69/17). Svi izrazi korišteni u natječaju odnose se na osobe oba spola. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu kandidati su dužni priložiti: - životopis (CV) sastavljen na hrvatskom i na talijanskom jeziku, - presliku diplome, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi, - dokaz o državljanstvu, - elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i - uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana objave ovog natječaja. Navedenu dokumentaciju potrebno je dostaviti neposredno ili poštom preporučeno na adresu škole, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave ovog natječaja na mrežnoj stranici Škole i mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, provjera poznavanja talijanskog jezika za kandidate koji nisu završili najmanje jedan obrazovni ciklus na talijanskom jeziku, sastav motivacijskog pisma i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. jobs.title: UREĐIVAČ/ICA VIDEOZAPISA / SADRŽAJA ZA DRUŠTVENE MREŽE
jobs.description:
Tražimo junior content creatora / video editora Rvstica (sapunerija.com) traži vrijednu i odgovornu osobu koja voli snimati i montirati video sadržaj. Moguće korištenje mjera aktivne politike zapošljavanja. Uvjeti radnog mjesta:
  • Puno radno vrijeme
  • Fleksibilno radno vrijeme
  • Plaća 1100 eura neto, dodatni bonus u postotku od konverzije ostvarene putem videa koje osoba snimi i montira.
  • Početak rada 1.10. 2026.
  • Potreban vlastiti prijevoz, zato je dobro imati osobni automobil.
Opis posla:
  • Snimanje kratkih video sadržaja za Reels, TikTok i Stories: proizvodnja sapuna, uživo radionice izrade sapuna, priroda, "behind the scenes", UGC videi s korištenjem proizvoda, priče o proizvodu.
  • Montiranje videa u CapCutu, uz dinamične rezove, titlove i ubacivanje slika.
  • Pisanje scenarija prema zadanim edukacijama, uz praćenje trendova na Instagramu i TikToku i predlaganje ideja za sadržaj.
  • Snimanje se odvija u Tučepima, dok se video montaža radi kod kuće.
Koga tražimo:
  • Osobu s osjećajem za vizualno pripovijedanje i ritam montaže, s iskustvom ili jakim interesom za CapCut i format Reels/TikTok.
  • Kreativnu, samoinicijativnu osobu s okom za detalje, vrijednu i marljivu, spremnu puno učiti i savladati edukacije koje odredimo. Prethodno profesionalno iskustvo nije potrebno.
  • Poželjno je poznavanje osnova marketinga društvenih mreža, fotografije i rada s kamerom, mobitel je dovoljan za početak. Zanimanje za prirodnu kozmetiku, održivost i "slow living" estetiku predstavlja prednost ali nije nužno.
Poslodavac nudi:
  • Rad na autentičnom, vizualno bogatom terenu (proizvodnja sapuna, maslinici, radionice izrade sapuna, konoba), kreativnu slobodu u oblikovanju sadržaja, plaćene edukacije video editinga i marketinga općenito, te dodatni bonus u postotku od konverzije videa.
  • Osobi koja pokaže rezultate i želju za razvojem nudimo mogućnost napredovanja unutar brenda, povećanje plaće uz kontinuirano mentorstvo i vođenje kroz edukacije.
Prijave slati na mail

jobs.title: Erfaren cykelmekaniker med sans for salg søges
jobs.description:
Vi søger ikke bare en mekaniker – vi søger den person, der kan blive butikkens ansigt udadtil og tage ansvar, som var det sin egen forretning.

Er du en dygtig og selvstændig cykelmekaniker med solid erfaring? Trives du med ansvar, kundekontakt og en varieret hverdag, hvor du selv er med til at få butikken til at fungere? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en erfaren cykelmekaniker, der kan tage ansvar for både butik og værksted i det daglige. Du skal være tryg ved at arbejde selvstændigt og kunne håndtere alt fra almindelige serviceeftersyn til fejlfinding og større reparationer på alle typer cykler, herunder ladcykler - har du erfaring med elcykler, er det et plus.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

* Har flere års erfaring som cykelmekaniker.

* Kan diagnosticere og løse alle typer mekaniske problemer på cykler.

* Er vant til at arbejde alene og tage ansvar for dagens opgaver.

* Er serviceminded og god til at rådgive kunder.

* Arbejder struktureret, effektivt og med fokus på kvalitet.

* Forstår at mersalg er en del af servicen.

Vi tilbyder

* En konkurrencedygtig løn, der matcher dine kvalifikationer.

* En varieret hverdag i en lille, lokal cykelbutik i Søborg.

* Stor frihed under ansvar og mulighed for at præge den daglige drift.

* Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med korte beslutningsveje.

* Mulighed for at blive en vigtig del af en butik, hvor godt håndværk og god kundeservice er i fokus. Vi sætter pris på vores ⭐️'er.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning og dit CV på mailen nedenunder. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Michelle Rasmussen

JM Cykler

kontakt@jmcykler.dk

jobs.title: Solutions Architect, Public Sector - East
Design Engineer (Web & Brand)
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We're looking for a Design Engineer with strong visual taste to help drive our creative initiatives across web and brand. When it comes to design and code, we’re looking to work with experienced people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story—what we're building and why it matters—as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

What you'll do

 - You will be responsible for building complex and interactive UI web/app experiences

 - Build beautiful, responsive websites, landing pages, and internal tools

 - Implement creative animations and interactions in code

 - Explore visual design in Figma and translate it to web-native experiences

What we're looking for

 - Eye for good design

 - Strong frontend engineering skills

 - Experience building end-to-end websites and landing pages

 - Experience with React and TypeScript

 - Experience using agentic coding tools as part of the design process (from exploring ideas to building production-quality interactions)

 - A portfolio or Twitter profile showcasing a range of technical skills, a creative use of code, and prototyping skills

What we offer

 - Interesting and challenging work

 - Work life balance

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms (extended exercise)

 - Paid lunch and coffee during work days

 - Work remotely, no commuting to the office

 - Paid co-working space/desk at an office

 - Regular team events and offsites

 - 5 weeks paid vacation

 - 4 months paid parental leave

jobs.title: PhD Position(s) in Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing for Living System Integration in Architecture
jobs.description:
SDU CREATE invites highly motivated candidates who wish to contribute to a regenerative built environment to apply for one or more PhD positions in Computational Design and Fabrication for Living System Integration in Architecture. The position(s) is expected to begin in January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The application deadline is 15 October 2026 at 23:59 CEST.

Scope of the work

The PhD position(s) is linked to the Villum CEBE programme, Civil Engineering and the Green Transition in the Built Environment, funded by the Villum Foundation. Within Research Field 2, Design for Regeneration, Circularity and Longevity, the research will develop architectural interfaces that support the establishment and growth of living systems, particularly photosynthetic communities, as a strategy for regenerative architecture. The focus is on enveloping surfaces in the built environment.

The project will focus on designing, testing and demonstrating, at architectural scale, porous mineral interfaces combined with hydrogels. Computational design, fabrication and environmental monitoring will be combined with cultivation experiments and biological assessment, targeting mosses, algae and cyanobacteria in collaboration with partner researchers in biology.

We seek candidates with primary expertise in one of two complementary research profiles:

  • Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing: exploring how architectural geometry, material composition and 3D printing can create bioreceptive interfaces. The work will combine computational design, printable material development, toolpath generation and robot programming to develop porous mineral interfaces informed by biological requirements.

  • Living Material Design and Biological Performance: developing hydrogels incorporating living organisms for integration into porous mineral interfaces. The work will combine formulation, cultivation, sensors, automated monitoring and data analysis to evaluate hygrothermal behaviour, biological growth, photosynthetic activity and material performance.

Both profiles require an interest in integrating biological systems and processes into architectural design and construction. The successful candidate(s) will collaborate within the team to develop and validate the resulting interfaces.

The candidate(s) will also contribute to the Centre’s activities, including teaching in the MSc CREATE programme and the BSc programme in Civil and Architectural Engineering through teaching, workshops and co-supervision of student projects.

Focus Area and Research Project

The research will investigate how material composition, porous morphologies and hygrothermal dynamics can support biological establishment and environmental performance, while addressing durability, maintenance and integration into building envelopes. Environmental measurements will help establish relationships between interface design, climatic exposure, biological development and performance.

The successful candidate(s) will contribute to selected areas according to their expertise, working within a team with complementary skills:

  • Computational design of bioreceptive mineral interfaces for enveloping surfaces in the built environment

  • Development and characterisation of printable mineral materials

  • Robotic 3D printing, toolpath generation and fabrication process development

  • Formulation of hydrogels incorporating living organisms and their integration into printed scaffolds

  • Cultivation experiments and assessment of biological growth and photosynthetic activity

  • Sensor integration, automated monitoring and data analysis to evaluate hygrothermal behaviour, ecological and microclimatic performance

  • Fabrication and evaluation of full-scale architectural demonstrators, addressing durability, maintenance and sustained biological growth

About SDU CREATE’s Research Environment

The Centre for Computational Research in Emergent Architectural Technology and Engineering, SDU CREATE, is led by Associate Professor Roberto Naboni. The Centre investigates advanced concepts and applications in architectural engineering, focusing on computational design, construction robotics, and material innovation. SDU CREATE brings together an international research team working across architectural engineering, computer science, robotics, materials science, and biology. Its research develops sustainable, regenerative approaches to designing and constructing the built environment.

Located within the Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark, SDU CREATE provides advanced laboratory facilities for robotic fabrication, additive and subtractive manufacturing, mixed reality applications in design and construction, and structural and mechanical testing. The facilities include industrial robotic systems, computational design platforms, and equipment for the experimental testing of materials, components, and structures. This environment supports interdisciplinary collaboration and partnerships with academic and industrial institutions in Denmark and internationally. The candidate(s) will work within a research culture that combines computational development with physical experimentation and full scale construction.

SDU CREATE is a partner in CEBE, a ten-year national research initiative funded by the Villum Foundation, in which Danish technical universities collaborate to advance the sustainability of the built environment within planetary boundaries. Within this initiative, SDU CREATE leads research in Digitalisation and Automation, RF4, and contributes to research in Design for Regeneration, Circularity, and Longevity, RF2. The programme provides a long-term research framework, access to national research networks, and opportunities for collaboration with academic and industrial partners.

Responsibilities

The successful candidate(s) will contribute to the development and delivery of CREATE’s research activities and laboratory-based investigations. Responsibilities include:

  • Conducting high-quality research within the defined research project and contributing original, scientifically rigorous outcomes

  • Conducting fabrication experiments and biological and environmental performance testing, including operation of robotic systems and laboratory equipment as relevant to the candidate’s research profile

  • Participating in CREATE’s research team activities, contributing to the development of design, fabrication, and testing frameworks

  • Developing and maintaining computational tools and workflows supporting the research activities

  • Assisting in teaching bachelor’s and master’s level courses and workshops, including co-supervision of thesis students and collaboration with interns in research-related activities

  • Disseminating research results through high-impact peer-reviewed publications and recognised international conferences

  • Sharing research outcomes through curated and high-quality outputs for digital platforms, exhibitions, and competitions

  • Contributing to the further development and maintenance of CREATE’s laboratory infrastructures and experimental facilities

  • Engaging with academic and industrial collaborators at the national and international level, including participation in the Villum CEBE research network

  • Assisting senior staff in the preparation of applications for external research funding

Engagement in these activities will evolve with the experience of the candidate(s), contributing to the Centre’s excellence and supporting their academic development, ideally towards future career advancement.

Candidate Requirements

Applications are invited from highly motivated candidates holding a Master’s degree in architecture, computational design, civil or architectural engineering, materials science, environmental engineering, biology, or other relevant disciplines related to the research areas. Candidates must demonstrate primary expertise in either Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing or Living Material Design and Biological Performance, and the ability to contribute to shared design, fabrication and validation activities.   • For the Living Material Design and Biological Performance profile: practical experience in material formulation and biological experimentation or cultivation, together with competence in experimental measurement and data analysis; experience with hydrogels, sensor integration, automated monitoring or hygrothermal characterisation are particularly valued

  • Hands-on laboratory experience, including physical prototyping or specimen preparation, and experimental testing relevant to the selected profile

  • Demonstrated capacity to conduct, document and disseminate projects and research outcomes suitable for peer-reviewed publication

  • Strong proficiency in English, both written and oral

  • Strong ability to work effectively within interdisciplinary teams and to coordinate and collaborate daily

  • Strong communication skills across graphical, written and oral formats

  • A proven track record of involvement in research or innovation projects; experience in teaching assistance, peer-reviewed publications or engagement with academic or industry stakeholders is evaluated positively

jobs.description:
The Department of Technology and Innovation (ITI) at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), section of Engineering Operations Management, invites applications for a 2-year position as Postdoc in Manufacturing Technology & Industrial Management.  The position is open from December 1, 2026, and the job location is Odense, Denmark.

 

Job description  

Successful candidates will drive internationally competitive research, collaborate in and across disciplines, work closely with industry and attract competitive external research and innovation funding in collaboration with senior researchers. The candidates will play a key role in providing outstanding education, supervise students, and develop junior research staff. 

 

We offer 

We offer a vigorous international research environment with a balance of male and female researchers, excellent facilities, including the new Robotics and Additive Manufacturing Laboratories at University of Southern Denmark, a long-term strategic initiative created to support research, teaching, and industrial collaboration and experimentation. SDU expects to increase its’ collaboration with industrial companies and associations in the coming years. 

This position will imply collaboration with industrial partners in the Renewable Energy Sector. Examples can be vendors of wind turbines, electrification solutions, electrolyzers, biogas equipment, carbon capture, utilization and storage technologies etc. It can also be major owners / operators of renewable energy plants, as offshore wind turbine park operators, green hydrogen / methanol / ammonia plants etc.

Research will be done to support DK and EU in realizing ambitions for production of green energy at off-take prices competitive with energy from fossil fuels via scaling and industrialization, whether the energy is in the form of green electricity or green fuels for industry and transport. There will be specific emphasis on research into the interplay between business strategy, product design, manufacturing systems design, manufacturing technology choices and scenarios or plans for industrial scaling. In addition to that, the position offers the opportunity to shape our educational and research and innovation programs by contributing to teaching and supervision in areas of Manufacturing technologies of the future and Industrial Management to benefit from new developments in research fields, approaches and content.

Candidates must have a relevant PhD.

jobs.title: PhD Scholarship in Software for Sustainable Farming
jobs.description:
Imagine a world where food production is in harmony with natural processes, farmers nurture healthy soils, and biodiversity thrives. In contrast, current monoculture farming systems undermine this future. Can you see how Robotics and Digital Twins can open opportunities for autonomously operating agricultural robots? Are you passionate about making agriculture more sustainable? If you share our passion for technology and the difference it can make in meeting the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals, perhaps you are our new PhD student.

At the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI), University of Southern Denmark in Odense, you will be part of the Robotic Intercropping (https://roboticintercropping.eu) team working to break new ground at the absolute forefront of what is possible in safe operation of autonomous agricultural vehicles. These are needed to enable better land use and management. This project promotes sustainable economic growth and higher levels of technological innovation. It will benefit society and create a safer and smarter world by providing decent work for all. Furthermore, autonomous robots will make current labor-intensive cultivation systems (e.g., strip-cropping, targeted mechanical weed control, etc.) profitable, contributing to increased biodiversity locally and reducing the need for insecticide use.

 

Responsibilities and qualifications

The PhD project is funded by a grant from the Novo Nordisk Foundation for the project Robotic Intercropping (https://roboticintercropping.eu). The project involves four research partners from Denmark and the Netherlands. Thus, this PhD project will be an integral part of a broader research team, consisting of collaborating partners with a common passion for autonomous agricultural robotics and new sustainable farming practices.

The PhD project will combine lightweight agricultural robots, manipulators for managing crop competition, and digital twins for modeling the working environment. If selected, your main focus will be.

  • Digital Twins (DT). Development of a sophisticated DT as a dynamic representation of the field, modeling crop growth, canopy architecture, and competition for light, water, and nutrients. Integrate advanced sensors (e.g., spectral, LiDAR) and simulation tools to guide robotic actions for yield optimization and enhanced biodiversity.

 

Team and role

You will: 

  • Be a core member of a team developing lightweight, modular robots and digital twins for scalable, precise interventions in complex intercropping environments.

  • Engage in interdisciplinary research integrating robotic systems and digital twins with multi-modal sensing and AI, aligned with agronomist-defined needs.

  • Participate in integration and field testing with Robotic Intercropping partners.

  • Design software architecture; integrate multi-modal data and models (e.g., crop competition, farm-level); implement “what-if” simulation; develop robust interfaces (e.g., ROS) for planning, navigation, and precision actions.

  • Collaborate with experts in plant science, robotics, statistics, and AI to bridge agroecology and robotic control.

At MMMI you will be a part of the Software Engineering unit. Expected outcomes include conference and journal publications, experimental validation, conference presentations, and teaching-assistant experience.

 

Appointment

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

The positions are available from December 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter. 

 

We expect

Degree. A two-year master’s degree (120 ECTS) in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or an equivalent field (or a comparable degree at the same academic level).

Nice to have:

  • Specialization in digital twins and software engineering of control systems (PhD#3).

  • Experience with swarm robotic systems, manipulator design, cyber-physical systems, SIMULINK, and robotic software development.

  • Knowledge of mechanical design, control system theory, statistics, actuation, sensing, rapid prototyping, and manufacturing.

  • Experience with tools such as ROS, Gazebo/NVIDIA Isaac/Omniverse or CoppeliaSim for simulation, and data/cloud platforms.

jobs.title: PhD Position in Reversible Programming for Energy Efficient Cyber-Physical Systems (MSCA Doctoral Network E-CoRe, DC12)
jobs.description:
The SDU Drone Center, part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD position on reversible programming languages and their use for energy efficient cyber-physical systems. The position is doctoral candidate DC12, "Energy Efficiency in Cyber-Physical Systems", in the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Network E-CoRe. The position is available from 1 January 2027, and the specific start date will be agreed upon with the successful candidate.

The application deadline is November 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST).

 

The position is funded by the European Union under the Horizon Europe Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Networks programme, grant agreement no. 101120187. MSCA eligibility rules apply, see the section "What we expect" below. Read more about the network at https://e-core.nws.cs.unibo.it/.

 

What we offer

E-CoRe is a European doctoral network on reversible computing. Reversible computation discards no information and therefore avoids the fundamental energy lower bound of conventional computing. The network trains a cohort of doctoral candidates who will improve and popularise reversible languages, algorithms, and architectures for energy-intensive applications. As one of the E-CoRe doctoral candidates you join a cohort at partner universities across Europe, take part in joint training schools and network events, and spend secondments at partner institutions, currently planned at the University of Bologna and the University of Manchester.

The main supervisor is Professor Ulrik Pagh Schultz, whose research spans programming languages, software engineering, robotics, and drones. You will be co-supervised by researchers from the Software Engineering section, and you will collaborate closely with the reversible computing group at the University of Copenhagen, which is also an E-CoRe partner. The position connects to other ongoing projects at the Drone Center, including WildBotics (a newly started Marie Skłodowska-Curie doctoral network) and Robotic Intercropping, and to local companies such as Spaceline.

The position addresses a programming languages question with an applied setting: how do we write software in reversible programming languages for systems where energy matters, and how much energy does this save? The setting is low-energy computations for cyber-physical systems such as perching aerial robots and IoT devices. The work belongs to the E-CoRe work package on applications and builds on the languages and tools developed elsewhere in the network. Concretely, the work includes the following:

  • Implementing algorithms in reversible programming languages and extending these languages where the application domain requires new constructs or idioms.

  • Integrating the resulting software into simulated cyber-physical systems, such as perching drones and IoT sensing scenarios.

  • Estimating energy consumption through combined hardware-level and system-level analysis, using the modelling framework developed in the network.

  • Answering the central research question of the position: how do the energy savings from reversible computation correlate with the I/O characteristics of the system?

  • Publishing the results at international conferences and in journals in programming languages, software engineering, and cyber-physical systems.

The position may involve co-supervising related student projects. You are expected to participate in the Drone Center's project portfolio and outreach activities and in the training programme of the E-CoRe network.

 

What we expect

We expect you to hold an MSc in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related field, or to complete one before the start date. The core of the work is programming languages and software. You do not need experience with drones or embedded hardware, and you do not need prior knowledge of reversible computing. You should have experience with, and an interest in, some of the following:

  • Programming language design and implementation.

  • Functional or declarative programming, or other work with languages beyond the mainstream.

  • Software design and development in languages such as C, C++, Rust, Python, or Haskell.

  • Algorithms and their analysis.

  • Simulation, modelling, or energy estimation of computing systems.

  • Embedded, real-time, or robotic software.

We expect you to write and speak English fluently, to work independently and with an international team, and to travel for the secondments and network events described above. We furthermore expect you to publish findings at recognised international conferences and in peer-reviewed journals.

The position follows the rules of the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions, and you must meet all of the following conditions at the recruitment date:

  • You do not hold a doctoral degree. Applicants who have defended a doctoral thesis but not yet been awarded the degree are not eligible.

  • Mobility rule: you have not resided or carried out your main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before the recruitment date. Short stays such as holidays are disregarded, as is compulsory national service and time covered by the 1951 Refugee Convention.

  • You are eligible regardless of nationality.

Recruitment follows the European Charter for Researchers and the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers. The process is open, transparent, merit-based, and equitable. The position is also announced on the Euraxess portal.

 

Workplace description

The SDU Drone Center is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at the Faculty of Engineering, located on the main SDU campus in Odense. At the center we research civilian drone technologies and their applications in agriculture, inspection, energy, healthcare, and nature conservation. We collaborate closely with companies in the robotics community around Odense and with research partners in Denmark and abroad. You will be part of an international group of PhD students, postdocs, engineers, and faculty working on autonomous systems and the software behind them.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

jobs.title: PhD Position(s) in Computational Design and Robotic Fabrication for Timber Upcycling
jobs.description:
SDU CREATE invites highly motivated candidates who wish to contribute to a more sustainable built environment to apply for a PhD position in Computational Design and Robotic Fabrication for Timber Upcycling. The position(s) are expected to begin in January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The application deadline is 15 October 2026 at 23:59 CEST.

 

Scope of the work

The PhD position(s) is linked to the Villum CEBE programme, Civil Engineering and the Green Transition in the Built Environment, funded by the Villum Foundation. Within Research Field 2, Design for Regeneration, Circularity and Longevity, the overall ambition is to extend the life cycle of reclaimed timber and retain its stored carbon for longer by transforming discarded wood into durable, materially efficient architectural components.

The research will investigate how heterogeneous pieces of waste timber can be reconstituted into engineered components with differentiated geometries and material properties. Computational design will connect architectural form, structural performance and available material stock, exploring how the arrangement, orientation and combination of reclaimed wood can generate new possibilities for building elements. The project will identify and develop suitable bonding techniques, integrate robotic fabrication with material characterisation, and demonstrate the resulting architectural systems at full scale.

We seek candidates with primary expertise in one of two complementary research profiles:

  • Computational Design and Robotic Fabrication: focusing on architectural design workflows, material allocation, robotic tooling, and the development of lamination, shaping and fabrication procedures for reclaimed timber.

  • AI-driven Computational Engineering: focusing on machine learning for material characterisation and property prediction, finite element modelling, structural optimisation, and experimental testing of timber, bonded interfaces and laminated components.

The successful candidate(s) will work within a team to develop and validate stock-informed design methods through computational investigation, hands-on fabrication experiments and full-scale architectural demonstrators. The candidate(s) will also contribute to the Centre’s activities, including teaching in the MSc CREATE programme and the BSc programme in Civil and Architectural Engineering through laboratory teaching, workshops, and co-supervision of student projects

 

Focus Area and Research Project

The research will develop new approaches to timber upcycling that minimise waste, extend carbon storage and advance circular construction. It will connect architectural design, material engineering and robotic fabrication to transform discarded timber into durable building components, developing lamination and bonding techniques alongside computational methods for design and structural optimisation.

The project builds on SDU CREATE’s previous research, including Re-VoxLam Truss and Re:Bridge, which explore how reclaimed timber can be reconstituted into structurally efficient architectural systems. Applicants are encouraged to consult the associated publications on reclaimed voxel lamination and stock and stress informed design and fabrication.

The successful candidate(s) will contribute to selected areas according to their expertise, working within a team with complementary skills:

  • Computational design and material allocation informed by available timber stock

  • Development of lamination and bonding techniques for architectural components

  • Robotic tooling and fabrication process development

  • Machine learning for material assessment and property prediction

  • Finite element modelling, structural optimisation and experimental validation

  • Fabrication and testing of full scale architectural demonstrators

  • Evaluation of material efficiency, structural performance and environmental benefits

 

About SDU CREATE’s Research Environment

The Centre for Computational Research in Emergent Architectural Technology and Engineering, SDU CREATE, is led by Associate Professor Roberto Naboni. The Centre investigates advanced concepts and applications in architectural engineering, focusing on computational design, construction robotics, and material innovation. SDU CREATE brings together an international research team working across architectural engineering, computer science, robotics, materials science, and biology. Its research develops sustainable, regenerative approaches to designing and constructing the built environment.

Located within the Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark, SDU CREATE provides advanced laboratory facilities for robotic fabrication, additive and subtractive manufacturing, mixed reality applications in design and construction, and structural and mechanical testing. The facilities include industrial robotic systems, computational design platforms, and equipment for the experimental testing of materials, components, and structures. This environment supports interdisciplinary collaboration and partnerships with academic and industrial institutions in Denmark and internationally. The candidate(s) will work within a research culture that combines computational development with physical experimentation and full scale construction.

SDU CREATE is a partner in CEBE, a ten-year national research initiative funded by the Villum Foundation, in which Danish technical universities collaborate to advance the sustainability of the built environment within planetary boundaries. Within this initiative, SDU CREATE leads research in Digitalisation and Automation, RF4, and contributes to research in Design for Regeneration, Circularity, and Longevity, RF2. The programme provides a long-term research framework, access to national research networks, and opportunities for collaboration with academic and industrial partners.

 

Responsibilities

The successful candidate(s) will contribute to the development and delivery of CREATE’s research activities and laboratory-based investigations. Responsibilities include:

  • Conducting high-quality research within the defined research project and contributing original, scientifically rigorous outcomes

  • Conducting fabrication and structural testing experiments, including operation of robotic systems and laboratory equipment as relevant to the candidate’s research profile

  • Participating in CREATE’s research team activities, contributing to the development of design, fabrication, and testing frameworks

  • Developing and maintaining computational tools and workflows supporting the research activities

  • Assisting in teaching bachelor’s and master’s level courses and workshops, including co-supervision of thesis students and collaboration with interns in research-related activities

  • Disseminating research results through high-impact peer-reviewed publications and recognised international conferences

  • Sharing research outcomes through curated and high-quality outputs for digital platforms, exhibitions, and competitions

  • Contributing to the further development and maintenance of CREATE’s laboratory infrastructures and experimental facilities

  • Engaging with academic and industrial collaborators at the national and international level, including participation in the Villum CEBE research network

  • Assisting senior staff in the preparation of applications for external research funding

Engagement in these activities will evolve with the experience of the candidate(s), contributing to the Centre’s excellence and supporting their academic development, ideally towards future career advancement.

 

Candidate Requirements

Applications are invited from highly motivated candidates holding a Master’s degree in architecture, civil or architectural engineering, robotics, mechanical engineering, materials science, or other relevant disciplines related to the research areas. Candidates must demonstrate primary expertise in either Computational Design and Robotic Fabrication or AI-driven Computational Engineering, together with the ability to contribute to shared design, fabrication and validation activities.

Candidates must demonstrate:

  • Documented interest and foundational knowledge in circular construction, timber engineering or material upcycling

  • Competence in Grasshopper and Rhino, advanced for the Computational Design and Robotic Fabrication profile and at working level for the AI-driven Computational Engineering profile, together with relevant programming skills such as Python or C#

  • For the Computational Design and Robotic Fabrication profile: practical experience in robotic fabrication and development of computational design workflows; experience developing robotic tools, fixtures or fabrication procedures is particularly valued

  • For the AI-driven Computational Engineering profile: competence in finite element analysis and structural optimisation; practical experience developing and evaluating machine learning models is particularly valued

  • Hands-on laboratory experience with fabrication, including physical prototyping or specimen preparation, and experimental testing relevant to the selected profile

  • Demonstrated capacity to conduct, document, and disseminate projects and research outcomes suitable for peer-reviewed publication

  • Strong proficiency in English, both written and oral

  • Strong ability to work effectively within interdisciplinary teams and to coordinate and collaborate daily

  • Strong communication skills across graphical, written, and oral formats

  • A proven track record of involvement in research or innovation projects; experience in teaching assistance, peer-reviewed publications or engagement with academic or industry stakeholders is evaluated positively

 

Contact information

For further information about the position(s) and SDU CREATE’s activities, please contact the Head of Centre, Associate Professor Roberto Naboni, at ron@iti.sdu.dk. For additional information on the Centre’s work, visit www.create-sdu.com.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Find full information on how to apply as well as assessment and employment terms on our website!

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, India
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer focused on migrations to join our growing team in India. You will help deliver complex, production-grade data migrations, integrations, and automations for customers across APAC.

This is initially an internally focused, hands-on engineering role. You will partner closely with regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who own customer discovery, solution architecture, stakeholder communication, risk management, and final customer validation. You will own the behind-the-scenes technical execution layer from feasibility assessment and implementation through testing, production rollout, QA, reconciliation, reporting, and operational handoff.

You will work across multiple customer environments and source systems, often with incomplete requirements, imperfect data, and real-world constraints. Success requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound judgment, careful validation, and the ability to turn one-off delivery work into reusable tools and repeatable playbooks.

As a founding engineer in India, you will help build a new regional engineering capability from the ground up. You will create migration infrastructure, standards, and reusable tooling used by FDEs across APAC, while establishing practices that can scale globally. The role offers an opportunity to become a technical authority for production migration delivery, shaping how Notion approaches reliability, validation, and operational quality across complex customer environments. As the team grows, the role may also expand toward customer-facing FDE work, technical leadership, or a deeper engineering path, depending on business needs and demonstrated capability.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the technical execution layer after customer requirements, scope, and solution architecture have been established with the regional FDE. Contribute to feasibility assessment, estimation, implementation planning, and risk identification while the regional FDE remains accountable for customer discovery, scope, architecture, stakeholder communication, and final acceptance.

 - Apply a repeatable migration lifecycle covering source inventory and sampling, scope and pruning decisions, compatibility and degradation assessment, transformation design, pilot or dry run, user acceptance testing, production cutover, reconciliation, remediation, hypercare, and documented handoff.

 - Translate approved customer and regional FDE requirements into clear technical designs, implementation plans, test strategies, runbooks, and delivery estimates.

 - Build production-quality migration utilities, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, and automations using Python, SQL, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.

 - Investigate source-system behavior, data quality issues, permissions, rate limits, authentication constraints, and edge cases, then recommend practical solutions.

 - Design and validate permissions, ownership, and inheritance mappings against the approved migration plan. Make unsupported or ambiguous access requirements explicit, obtain the required decision or approval, and preserve evidence of validation.

 - Design migrations for reliability, scale, security, observability, idempotency, failure recovery, and safe reruns.

 - Execute migrations only through approved environments, devices, accounts, and tooling. Follow least-privilege access, customer-specific security and data-residency requirements, and approved handling procedures. Do not store customer data in unmanaged local or external systems, and escalate privacy, security, or sovereignty concerns before execution.

 - Build validation and reconciliation frameworks that provide clear evidence of migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions.

 - Debug failures across application code, infrastructure, customer data, third-party systems, and the Notion platform, then drive issues through resolution.

 - Manage multiple implementation workstreams, dependencies, and priorities while communicating scope, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly.

 - Surface scope changes, unsupported requirements, timeline risks, and material effort increases early. Document assumptions and trade-offs, and escalate with options and a recommended path rather than silently absorbing additional work.

 - Maintain an auditable record of scope, decisions, risks, approvals, validation evidence, and customer acceptance criteria in the agreed shared workspace or channel.

 - Convert repeated delivery patterns into reusable components, automation, documentation, and playbooks that improve speed, quality, and cost over time.

 - Bring field learnings back to Notion's Product and Engineering teams as actionable platform feedback and technical requirements.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in backend engineering, data engineering, integration engineering, implementation engineering, technical consulting, solutions engineering, or a similar technical role.

 - Strong hands-on Python development experience.

 - Working experience with Node.js, JavaScript, or TypeScript.

 - Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, and data transformation.

 - Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, webhooks, and system integrations.

 - Experience owning a production migration, integration, or technical implementation through mapping, transformation, testing, rollout, validation, and handoff.

 - Experience taking a technical problem from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production operation.

 - Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, release practices, and production deployment.

 - Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills across code, data, infrastructure, and external systems.

 - Evidence of working on production systems, not only prototypes or proof-of-concept projects.

 - Clear written and verbal English communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions, constraints, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - High agency and ownership. You are comfortable making progress with incomplete information, challenging assumptions, and escalating with options and a recommendation.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, job orchestration, or infrastructure automation.

 - Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.

 - Familiarity with message queues, event-driven systems, distributed-system patterns, retries, concurrency, and rate limits.

 - Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, or other observability tools.

 - Experience with enterprise SaaS applications, professional services, or large-scale customer implementations.

 - Experience migrating large volumes of content or structured data between enterprise platforms.

 - Experience with AI or LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, or agentic workflows.

 - Familiarity with MCP, tool calling, Notion Workers, Custom Agents, or similar extensibility platforms.

 - Experience working with distributed global or APAC teams.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

In your first 90 days, you will:

 - Learn Notion's migration and implementation ecosystem, engineering standards, and APAC delivery model.

 - Establish a productive working rhythm with regional FDE partners.

 - Contribute to at least one migration or integration workstream through production delivery.

 - Leave behind clear technical documentation, validation evidence, and an operational runbook.

Within your first six months, you will:

 - Independently own production migration or integration workstreams from technical design through rollout and handoff.

 - Deliver measurable improvements in migration turnaround time, validation quality, delivery cost, or regional FDE execution hours through reusable engineering.

 - Help establish repeatable quality controls, code review practices, runbooks, and observability patterns for the India team.

 - Demonstrate effective prioritization and communication across multiple concurrent APAC engagements.

 - Turn at least one repeated delivery pattern into a reusable tool, component, or playbook that is adopted by a subsequent engagement.




LOCATION:

This role is based in Hyderabad, India. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our Anchor Days, because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We're looking for someone who's excited to work alongside the team during those days.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Personal Assistant to Grenoble France
jobs.description:
Core mission
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.
You will join the ILL's Reactor Division, where you will perform secretarial duties for the Head of Division and provide general administrative support to the entire division. This role is at the heart of the ILL's relations with France's nuclear safety and security authorities. It calls for a meticulous approach to the handling of sensitive documents and involves working in close collaboration with the personal assistants of the other members of the ILL's Management Board. Special security clearance ('habilitation') is required for this post, given the sensitive nature of some of the documents and activities associated with the role.

Your tasks
. Handle administrative relations with the French authorities (French nuclear safety authority (ASNR), Senior Defence and Security Advisor (HFDS) within the Ministry of Ecological Transition and its technical support services, Préfecture, police): processing, distributing and archiving incoming and outgoing correspondence, maintaining the correspondence register.
. Manage the logistics involved with inspections (ASNR, HFDS, EURATOM) and emergency response exercises.
. Handle documents classified as "Secret" and "Restricted" and monitor compliance with the associated security clearance and screening procedures.
. Handle administrative matters linked to crisis management: badges for access to CEA Grenoble, maintaining the list of ILL staff who may be involved and the associated documentation.
. Remain up to date with safety reference frameworks (safety report, general operating rules, on-site emergency plan and safety instruction sheets) and regulatory documents relating to nuclear materials, as well as documents governing reactor operations (procedures, RHF reactor reports, instructions).
. Organise regular meetings of the Reactor Division and draft the associated minutes.
. Organise important visits to the Reactor Division (safety authorities, public authorities) and other events, in collaboration with the other personal assistants.
. Perform secretarial duties for the Head of the Reactor Division: managing his agenda, phone calls, emails, correspondence, travel arrangements and travel expenses.
. Coordinate the annual performance reviews and manage data forwarded to the Joint Careers Commission.
. Collaborate with the personal assistants of the other members of the Management Board to ensure that actions are effectively coordinated in line with the objectives set.

our profile
. Level 4/5 qualification in business and administration or a related field, or administrative secretary and personal assistant diploma
. Proven experience as a personal assistant
. Excellent command of written and spoken English and French
. Meticulous nature and professionalism, particularly in the handling of sensitive and/or classified documents
. Strong organisational skills, ability to manage a variety of tasks simultaneously and liaise with multiple stakeholders
. Ability to perform day-to-day tasks independently
. Good interpersonal and teamwork skills, particularly when coordinating with the other personal assistants.

What we offer
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal by 04/10/2026, quoting reference number 26/39. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.
